###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/27)


**אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ**וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ יַעֲלֶה וְיָבֹא וְיַגִּֽיעַ וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר זִכְרוֹנֵֽנוּ וּפִקְדוֹנֵֽנוּ וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִֽׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ וְזִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפָנֶֽיךָ. לִפְלֵיטָה לְטוֹבָה לְחֵן וּלְחֶֽסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם בְּיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים הַזֶּה. זָכְרֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה. וּפָקְדֵֽנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה. וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים. וּבִדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים חוּס וְחָנֵּֽנוּ. וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ. כִּי אֵלֶֽיךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ. כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה:


**Our God** and God of our fathers, may there ascend, come, and reach, appear, be desired, and heard, counted and recalled our remembrance and reckoning; the remembrance of our fathers; the remembrance of the Messiah the son of Dovid, Your servant; the remembrance of Yerushalayim, city of Your Sanctuary and the remembrance of Your entire people, the House of Yisrael, before You for survival, for well-being, for favor, kindliness, compassion, for life and peace on this Day of Atonement. Remember us Adonoy, our God on this day for well-being; be mindful of us on this day for blessing, and deliver us for life. In accord with the promise of deliverance and compassion, spare us and favor us, have compassion on us and deliver us; for to You our eyes are directed because You are the Almighty, Who is King, Gracious and Merciful.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/28)


**אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ**וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ. מְחֹל לַעֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ (בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וּ) בְּיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים הַזֶּה. מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ. כָּאָמוּר אָנֹכִי אָנֹכִי הוּא מוֹחֶה פְשָׁעֶֽיךָ לְמַעֲנִי וְחַטֹּאתֶֽיךָ לֹא אֶזְכֹּר: וְנֶאֱמַר מָחִֽיתִי כָעָב פְּשָׁעֶֽיךָ וְכֶעָנָן חַטֹּאתֶֽיךָ שׁוּבָה אֵלַי כִּי גְאַלְתִּֽיךָ: וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תִּטְהָֽרוּ:


**Our God** and God of our fathers, forgive our iniquities 
*On Shabbos add:*
 (on this Shabbos day, and) on this Day of Atonement. Blot out and remove our transgressions and sins⁵⁰ from before Your eyes, as it is said: “I, I [alone] am He Who blots out your transgressions for My own sake;⁵¹ and your sins, I will not recall.”⁵² And it is said, “I have swept away like a thick cloud⁵³ your transgressions, and like a mist⁵⁴ your sins; return to Me, for I have redeemed you.”⁵⁵ And it is said, “For on this day He will make atonement for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins, before Adonoy, you will be cleansed.”⁵⁶

footnotes:
⁵⁰ Were it not for the intervention of the wondrous power of Hashem’s grace, our moral and physical entity would have long ceased, as a consequence of our transgressions. This would have been our fate in accordance with the law of cause and effect which functions in Hashem’s world according to His will. It is only Hashem Himself, He Who originally ordained that law, Who in the omnipotence of His will, can also suspend that law. Only He can cause the wrong which was done to become as if it had never occurred. Only Hashem can uproot in its entirety the sin and consequential effect of sin. He has assured this wondrous power of His benevolent grace to every Jew who fulfills the true purpose of Yom Kippur by doing teshuva, true repentance. Thus we cry out to Him “Blot out and remove our transgressions and sins from before Your eyes” for in the words of the prophet, Hashem alone blots out our transgressions.
⁵¹ Were Hashem to destroy us because of our transgressions, His Name would be desecrated among the nations of the world. Thus says the prophet, He blots out our transgressions for His own sake.—Metsudas DovidAccording to Malbim, “for My own sake” implies for the sake of the favor and lovingkindness which is His attribute (כִּי חָפֵץ חֶסֶד אָנִי).
⁵² Yeshaya 42:25. This implies that our sins will be blotted out so thoroughly that not even the slightest trace will remain. Thus says Hashem, “and your sins, I will not recall” because there will be nothing left to recall.—Metsudas Dovid
⁵³ The word פְּשָׁעֶיךָ, your transgressions, which implies a wanton disregard of Hashem’s will is compared to an עָב, a thick cloud. Just as a thick cloud darkens the earth so too, our transgressions cause darkness in our lives.—Malbim
⁵⁴ The word חַטֹּאתֶיךָ, your sins, which implies error, or sins committed unknowingly, is compared to an עָנָן, a mist cloud, which does not cause such terrible darkness. So too, our sins do not create such severe blackness in our lives.—Malbim
⁵⁵ Yeshaya 44:22
⁵⁶ In our translation, the words, מִכֹּל חַטֹאתֵיכֶם are joined with the words לִפְנֵי ה' תִּטְהָרוּ, thus reading “from all your sins before Adonoy, you will be cleansed”; implying that the entire sentence is a statement of fact, i.e., that Yom Kippur is a day in which Hashem atones our sins. According to Targum Yonassan ben Uziel, however, the words מִכֹּל חַטֹאתֵיכֶם are joined to the previous words—לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם—changing the entire concept of the sentence. According to the Targum the sentence reads: כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹאתֵיכֶם. “For on this day He will make atonement for you to cleanse you from all your sins”; and thus the final three words of the sentence לִפְנֵי ה' תִּטְהָרוּ represent a command to cleanse ourselves before Him, as the Targum says: וְאַתּוּן קָדָם ה' תּוֹדוּן סוּרְחָנוּתְכוֹן וְתִדְכּוּן “And you—confess your wrongdoings before Hashem, and then you will be cleansed.” Klei Yakar, obviously influenced by Targum explicitly states that this sentence is not a blanket promise of atonement, for Yom Kippur atones only for those who cleanse themselves with honest repentance.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/29)


(אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵֽנוּ) קַדְּשֵֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ שַׂבְּעֵֽנוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵֽנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ: (וְהַנְחִילֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ וְיָנֽוּחוּ בוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶֽךָ) וְטַהֵר לִבֵּֽנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת כִּי אַתָּה סָלְחָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וּמָחֳלָן לְשִׁבְטֵי יְשֻׁרוּן בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר וּמִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ לַעֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ וְלַעֲו‍ֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל. וּמַעֲבִיר אַשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּכָל שָׁנָה וְשָׁנָה. מֶֽלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ) יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים:


*On Shabbos add:*
 (Our God and God of our fathers, be pleased with our rest) Sanctify us with Your commandments and give us our share in Your Torah; satisfy us from Your goodness and gladden us with Your deliverance, 
*On Shabbos add:*
 (And give us as our inheritance Adonoy our God with love and with pleasure Your holy Sabbath; and may Yisrael rest thereon— [they who are] sanctifiers of Your Name) and purify our hearts to serve You in truth, For You are the Pardoner⁵⁷ of Yisrael, and the Forgiver⁵⁷ of the tribes of Yeshurun in every generation, and beside You, we have no king who forgives and pardons, only You! Blessed are You, King Who forgives and pardons our iniquities, and the iniquities of His people, the House of Yisrael; and Who removes our trespasses each year; King over the whole earth, Sanctifier 
*On Shabbos add:*
 (of the Shabbos and) of Yisrael and the Day of Atonement.

footnotes:
⁵⁷ The words סָלְחָן and מָחֳלָן (Pardoner and Forgiver) indicate that Hashem constantly pardons and forgives. He is not like a king who pardons only at times but His Divine attribute is to be a סָלְחָן and מָחֳלָן at all times. He is thus intrinsically a Pardoner and Forgiver.— Pesher Dovor
⁵⁷ The words סָלְחָן and מָחֳלָן (Pardoner and Forgiver) indicate that Hashem constantly pardons and forgives. He is not like a king who pardons only at times but His Divine attribute is to be a סָלְחָן and מָחֳלָן at all times. He is thus intrinsically a Pardoner and Forgiver.— Pesher Dovor

**רְצֵה**יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם, וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶֽךָ וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ: וְתֶחֱזֶֽינָה עֵינֵֽינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן:


**Be pleased,** Adonoy, our God, with Your people Yisrael and their prayer; and restore the service to the Holy of Holies in Your abode, and the fire-offerings of Yisrael; and accept their prayer, lovingly and willingly. And may You always find pleasure with the service of Your people, Yisrael. And may our eyes behold Your merciful return to Tziyon. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who returns His Divine Presence to Tziyon.

###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/34)


**מוֹדִים** אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד צוּר חַיֵּֽינוּ מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ עַל חַיֵּֽינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶֽךָ וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ וְעַל נִסֶּֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּֽנוּ וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶֽרֶב וָבֹֽקֶר וְצָהֳרָֽיִם, הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ, מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ:


**We** are thankful to You that You Adonoy are our God and the God of our fathers forever; Rock of our lives, Shield of our deliverance, You are in every generation. We will give thanks to You and recount Your praise, for our lives which are committed into Your hand, and for our souls which are entrusted to You, and for Your miracles of every day with us, and for Your wonders and benefactions at all times— evening, morning and noon. (You are) The Beneficent One— for Your compassion is never withheld; And (You are) the Merciful One— for Your kindliness never ceases; we have always placed our hope in You.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/35)


**וְעַל** כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ:


**And** for all the foregoing blessed and exalted be your Name, our King constantly, forever and ever. Inscribe for a good life all the children of Your covenant.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/37)


וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵֽנוּ סֶֽלָה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:


And all the living shall thank You forever and praise Your Name with sincerity the Almighty, Who is our deliverance and our help forever. Blessed are You, Adonoy, “The Beneficent” is Your Name and You it is fitting to praise.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/39)


**שלום**


**PRAYER FOR PEACE**


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 40

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/40](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/40)


**שָׁלוֹם**רָב עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּךָ. תָּשִׂים לְעוֹלָם כִּי אַתָּה הוּא מֶֽלֶךְ אָדוֹן לְכָל הַשָּׁלוֹם וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל עֵת וּבְכָל שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ.


Abundant peace upon Yisrael, Your people, bestow forever, for You King are Master of all peace. And may it be good in Your eyes and to bless Your people Yisrael, at all times and at every moment with Your peace.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/41)


**בְּסֵֽפֶר** חַיִּים בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה נִזָּכֵר וְנִכָּתֵב לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְכָל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם:


**In the book** of life, blessing, peace and abundant maintenance, may we be remembered and inscribed before You; we and all Your people, the House of Yisrael for a good life and peace.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 43

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/43](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/43)


בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם: הַמְּבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם:


Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who makes the peace. 
*(others conclude—*
 Who blesses His people Yisrael with peace.)


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 44

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/44](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/44)


יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:


May the words of my mouth be acceptable and the thoughts of my heart — before You Adonoy, my Rock and my Redeemer.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/45)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ תָּבֹא לְפָנֶֽיךָ תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ, וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתֵֽנוּ שֶׁאֵין אֲנַֽחְנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וּקְשֵׁי עֹֽרֶף לוֹמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ צַדִּיקִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְלֹא חָטָֽאנוּ אֲבָל אֲנַֽחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ חָטָֽאנוּ:


Our God and God of our fathers, let our prayer come before you and do not ignore our supplication. For we are not so brazen-faced and stiff-necked to say to you, Adonoy, our God, and God of our fathers, “We are righteous and have not sinned.” But, indeed, we and our fathers have sinned.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/46)


אָשַֽׁמְנוּ. בָּגַֽדְנוּ. גָּזַֽלְנוּ. דִּבַּֽרְנוּ דֹּֽפִי. הֶעֱוִֽינוּ. וְהִרְשַֽׁעְנוּ. זַֽדְנוּ. חָמַֽסְנוּ. טָפַֽלְנוּ שֶֽׁקֶר. יָעַֽצְנוּ רָע. כִּזַּֽבְנוּ. לַֽצְנוּ. מָרַֽדְנוּ. נִאַֽצְנוּ. סָרַֽרְנוּ. עָוִֽינוּ. פָּשַֽׁעְנוּ. צָרַֽרְנוּ. קִשִּֽׁינוּ עֹֽרֶף. רָשַֽׁעְנוּ. שִׁחַֽתְנוּ. תִּעַֽבְנוּ. תָּעִֽינוּ. תִּעְתָּֽעְנוּ:


We have trespassed [against God and man, and we are devastated by our guilt]; We have betrayed [God and man, we have been ungrateful for the good done to us]; We have stolen; We have slandered. We have caused others to sin; We have caused others to commit sins for which they are called רְשָׁעִים, wicked; We have sinned with malicious intent; We have forcibly taken others' possessions even though we paid for them; We have added falsehood upon falsehood; We have joined with evil individuals or groups; We have given harmful advice; We have deceived; we have mocked; We have rebelled against God and His Torah; We have caused God to be angry with us; We have turned away from God's Torah; We have sinned deliberately; We have been negligent in our performance of the commandments; We have caused our friends grief; We have been stiff-necked, refusing to admit that our suffering is caused by our own sins. We have committed sins for which we are called רָשָׁע, [raising a hand to hit someone]. We have committed sins which are the result of moral corruption; We have committed sins which the Torah refers to as abominations; We have gone astray; We have led others astray.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/47)


סַֽרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ הַטּוֹבִים וְלֹא שָֽׁוָה לָֽנוּ. וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל הַבָּא עָלֵֽינוּ. כִּי אֱמֶת עָשִֽׂיתָ וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ:


We have turned away from Your commandments and from Your good laws, and we have gained nothing from it. And You are the Righteous One in all [punishment] that has come upon us; for You have acted truthfully and we have acted wickedly.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/48)


מַה נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יוֹשֵׁב מָרוֹם. וּמַה נְּסַפֵּר לְפָנֶֽיךָ שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים. הֲלֹא כָּל הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת וְהַנִּגְלוֹת אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ:


What shall we say before You, Who dwells on high; and what shall we relate to You Who dwells in the heavens? For everything, both hidden and revealed, You know.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 49

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/49](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/49)


אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ רָזֵי עוֹלָם. וְתַעֲלוּמוֹת סִתְרֵי כָל חָי: אַתָּה חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן וּבוֹחֵן כְּלָיוֹת וָלֵב: אֵין דָּבָר נֶעְלָם מִמֶּֽךָּ. וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ: וּבְכֵן יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ. שֶׁתְּכַפֵּר לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ. וְתִסְלַח לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל עֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ. וּתִמְחָל לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ:


You know the mysteries of the universe, and the hidden secrets of every individual. You search all our innermost thoughts,⁵⁸ and probe our mind⁵⁹ and heart. There is nothing hidden from You, and there is nothing concealed from Your sight. And so may it be Your will Adonoy our God and God of our fathers, that You pardon us for all our careless sins, and that You forgive us for all our deliberate sins, and that You grant us atonement for all our rebellious sins:

footnotes:
⁵⁸ The literal meaning of חַדְרֵי בָטֶן is “chambers of the stomach,” but according to Ibn Ezra to Mishlei 20:27, from which the expression is taken, חַדְרֵי בָטֶן refers to the heart which is the innermost chamber of human thought.
⁵⁹ The literal meaning of כְּלָיוֹת is “kidneys,” which are said to give counsel to the heart.— Avudraham


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/50)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאֹֽנֶס וּבְרָצוֹן:


For the sin we committed before You under compulsion⁶⁰ and willingly.

footnotes:
⁶⁰ Even a sin committed under duress needs to be forgiven, because many times a person allows himself to be placed in a predicament in which he is compelled to sin (e.g., leaving the office at a very late hour on the eve of Shabbos or Festival).—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/51)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאִמּוּץ הַלֵּב:


And for the sin we committed before You by callously hardening the heart.⁶¹

footnotes:
⁶¹ This would include not giving charity with a whole heart, and not helping a needy fellow Jew.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/52)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּבְלִי דָֽעַת:


For the sin we committed before You inadvertently.⁶²

footnotes:
⁶² The literal meaning of בִּבְלִי דַעַת is “without knowledge,” and it implies not using our intellectual capabilities to study the laws of Torah and therewith gain the “knowledge” needed to observe the commandments properly.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 53

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/53](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/53)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּבִטּוּי שְׂפָתָֽיִם:


And for the sin we committed before You with an utterance of the lips.⁶³

footnotes:
⁶³ This includes the sins of making vows and oaths (even though they are kept), verbally insulting one’s fellowmen, and directing one’s displeasure against the decrees of Hashem.— Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 54

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/54](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/54)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּגָלוּי וּבַסָּֽתֶר:


For the sin we committed before You openly and secretly.⁶⁴

footnotes:
⁶⁴ A sin committed publicly could very well cause חִלוּל ה', the desecration of Hashem’s Name, and may also lead others to sin. A sin committed in secret, indicates that the sinner fears the reaction of people but is unafraid of Hashem’s displeasure.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 55

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/55](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/55)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּגִלּוּי עֲרָיוֹת:


And for the sin we committed before You in sexual immorality.⁶⁵

footnotes:
⁶⁵ This also includes such things that arouse desire for forbidden sexual relationships, such as embracing or dancing.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 56

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/56](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/56)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּדִבּוּר פֶּה:


For the sin we committed before You through [misuse of our power of] speech.⁶⁶

footnotes:
⁶⁶ This includes speaking the words of Torah in unclean places, cursing, humiliating someone; speaking of business matters on Shabbos, revealing another person’s secret, telling jokes and holding idle conversations in a house of worship (and certainly during the actual prayers) and telling lies.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 57

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/57](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/57)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּדַעַת וּבְמִרְמָה:


And for the sin we committed before You with knowledge and with deceit.⁶⁷

footnotes:
⁶⁷ This includes false advertising and dishonesty in business matters.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 58

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/58](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/58)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּהַרְהוֹר הַלֵּב:


For the sin we committed before You by improper thoughts.⁶⁸

footnotes:
⁶⁸ Evil thoughts, lustful thoughts, heretical thoughts, and suspicious thoughts about righteous people are included.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 59

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/59](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/59)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּהוֹנָֽאַת רֵֽעַ:


And for the sin we committed before You by cheating a fellow-man.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 60

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/60](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/60)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּוִדּוּי פֶּה:


For the sin we committed before You with [mere] verbal confession.⁶⁹

footnotes:
⁶⁹ This refers to confession of sins without feeling regret for committing them and without earnest resolve to correct them in the future.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 61

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/61](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/61)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּוְעִידַת זְנוּת:


And for the sin we committed before You by joining in a lewd gathering.⁷⁰

footnotes:
⁷⁰ Any gathering or intimate meeting for the purpose of sexual immortality is included.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 62

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/62](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/62)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּזָדוֹן וּבִשְׁגָגָה:


For the sin we committed before You intentionally and unintentionally.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 63

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/63](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/63)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּזִלְזוּל הוֹרִים וּמוֹרִים:


And for the sin we committed before You by insufficient respect for parents and teachers.⁷¹

footnotes:
⁷¹ Not obeying their commands, not rising for a talmudic scholar and disrespect for one’s teacher even if he is not considered a “Torah Great” are included.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 64

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/64](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/64)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּחֹֽזֶק יָד:


For the sin we committed before You by using coercion [to harm others].⁷²

footnotes:
⁷² This includes using physical, political or financial power to harm someone.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 65

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/65](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/65)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּחִלּוּל הַשֵּׁם:


And for the sin we committed before You by desecrating the Divine Name.⁷³

footnotes:
⁷³ This involves any sin committed that becomes public knowledge, including improper conduct with one’s fellow man.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 66

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/66](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/66)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּטִפְשׁוּת פֶּה:


For the sin we committed before You with foolish talk.⁷⁴

footnotes:
⁷⁴ This refers to idle talk and gossip.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 67

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/67](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/67)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּטֻמְאַת שְׂפָתָֽיִם:


And for the sin we committed before You with impurity of the lips.⁷⁵

footnotes:
⁷⁵ This includes profanity and unclean language.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 68

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/68](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/68)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּיֵֽצֶר הָרָע:


For the sin we committed before You with the Evil Inclination.⁷⁶

footnotes:
⁷⁶ When a person allows his Evil Inclination to rule over him, he commits a sin.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 69

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/69](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/69)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּיוֹדְעִים וּבְלֹא יוֹדְעִים:


And for the sin we committed before You knowingly and unknowingly.⁷⁷

footnotes:
⁷⁷ We ask Hashem to pardon us even for sins we are not aware that we committed, and also for such sins through which we caused damage but are not aware of the amount of loss incurred.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 70

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/70](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/70)


וְעַל כֻּלָּם אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת. סְלַח לָֽנוּ. מְחַל לָֽנוּ. כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ:


And for all of these, God of pardon, pardon us, forgive us, grant us atonement.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 71

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/71](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/71)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּכַפַּת שֹֽׁחַד:


For the sin we committed before You by forcing someone to give or take bribes.⁷⁸

footnotes:
⁷⁸ A bribe is not limited to money or gifts; it includes flattery or personal favors.— Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 72

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/72](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/72)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּכַֽחַשׁ וּבְכָזָב:


And for the sin we committed before You by false denial and false promise.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 73

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/73](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/73)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּלָשׁוֹן הָרָע:


For the sin we committed before You by evil talk [slander].⁷⁹

footnotes:
⁷⁹ This includes causing a fellow Jew physical, monetary of social harm through passing degrading information about him to another person. It makes no difference whether this is done in his presence or behind his back, or if the information is true or false.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 74

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/74](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/74)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּלָצוֹן:


And for the sin we committed before You by scoffing.⁸⁰

footnotes:
⁸⁰ Ridicule of a person, a commandment, or guards of Torah are all included in the sin of scoffing.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 75

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/75](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/75)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּמַשָּׂא וּבְמַתָּן:


For the sin we committed before You in business dealings.⁸¹

footnotes:
⁸¹ This would include overcharging, misrepresenting, false-labeling and all other such deceitful practices.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 76

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/76](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/76)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּמַאֲכָל וּבְמִשְׁתֶּה:


And for the sin we committed before You in eating and drinking.⁸²

footnotes:
⁸² Eating forbidden (non-kosher) foods, not saying the proper blessing or grace after meals, over-eating, are included in this sin.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 77

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/77](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/77)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּנֶֽשֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּית:


For the sin we committed before You by [taking or giving] interest and by usury.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 78

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/78](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/78)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּנְטִיַּת גָּרוֹן:


And for the sin we committed before You by haughtily stretching forth the neck.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 79

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/79](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/79)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּשִׂקּוּר עָֽיִן:


For the sin we committed before You with gazing of the eyes.⁸³

footnotes:
⁸³ This refers to using the eyes to gaze at forbidden things.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 80

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/80](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/80)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּשִֽׂיחַ שִׂפְתוֹתֵֽינוּ:


And for the sin we committed before You by the prattle of our lips.⁸⁴

footnotes:
⁸⁴ This includes idle gossip, which is certainly forbidden in the synagogue at all times.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 81

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/81](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/81)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּעֵינַֽיִם רָמוֹת:


For the sin we committed before You with haughty eyes.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 82

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/82](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/82)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּעַזּוּת מֶֽצַח:


And for the sin we committed before You with impudence.⁸⁵

footnotes:
⁸⁵ Speaking “with chutzpah” to Torah scholars, or to someone more learned than himself is included in עַזּוּת מֵצַח.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 83

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/83](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/83)


וְעַל כֻּלָּם אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת. סְלַח לָֽנוּ. מְחַל לָֽנוּ. כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ:


And for all of these, God of pardon, pardon us, forgive us, grant us atonement.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 84

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/84](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/84)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּפְרִֽיקַת עֹל:


For the sin we committed before You by throwing off the yoke [of heaven].⁸⁶

footnotes:
⁸⁶ Rejecting an obligation to fulfill even a single commandment. Also included is shirking a religious obligation which must then be assumed by someone else.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 85

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/85](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/85)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּפְלִילוּת:


And for the sin we committed before You in passing judgment.⁸⁷

footnotes:
⁸⁷ This includes a “Dayan,” a judge who does not render correct decisions, and it also includes not giving someone the benefit of the doubt.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 86

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/86](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/86)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּצְדִיַּת רֵֽעַ:


For the sin we committed before You by entrapping a fellowman.⁸⁸

footnotes:
⁸⁸ This includes even attempting to harm someone; even if no harm was actually done, he still needs forgiveness.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 87

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/87](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/87)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּצָרוּת עָֽיִן:


And for the sin we committed before You by a begrudging eye.⁸⁹

footnotes:
⁸⁹ Not doing a favor, not giving charity properly, and feeling bad at someone else’s success are included.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 88

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/88](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/88)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּקַלּוּת רֹאשׁ:


For the sin we committed before You by lightmindedness.⁹⁰

footnotes:
⁹⁰ Lightmindedness or frivolity in the synagogue or Bais Midrash or while wearing tefillin are serious sins.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 89

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/89](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/89)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּקַשְׁיוּת עֹֽרֶף:


And for the sin we committed before You by being stiff-necked [stubborn].⁹¹

footnotes:
⁹¹ Rejecting admonition and “ignoring” punishment are included. Also included is brushing aside illness, financial loss, and humiliation as mere coincidences rather than manifestations of Divine displeasure.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 90

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/90](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/90)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּרִיצַת רַגְלַֽיִם לְהָרַע:


For the sin we committed before You by running to do evil.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 91

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/91](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/91)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּרְכִילוּת:


And for the sin we committed before You by talebearing.⁹²

footnotes:
⁹² This refers to carrying tales, even true ones, about one person to another, and the one who listens to these tales is also included in this category of sin.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 92

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/92](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/92)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּשְׁבֽוּעַת שָׁוְא:


For the sin we committed before You by swearing in vain.⁹³

footnotes:
⁹³ This includes swearing falsely or even swearing a useless oath.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 93

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/93](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/93)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּשִׂנְאַת חִנָּם:


And for the sin we committed before You by unwarranted hatred.⁹⁴

footnotes:
⁹⁴ Hating someone because of jealousy, or because he doesn’t conform to your ideas of ettiquete.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 94

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/94](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/94)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּתְשֽׂוּמֶת יָד:


For the sin we committed before You by breach of trust.⁹⁵

footnotes:
⁹⁵ Denying that you owe someone a monetary debt when he asks for payment.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 95

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/95](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/95)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּתִמְהוֹן לֵבָב:


And for the sin we committed before You by a confused heart.⁹⁶

footnotes:
⁹⁶ This includes sins committed because of confusion, worry or pain, it also includes the sin of harboring doubts about the authenticity of the laws enacted by our Sages, and doubts about the fundamental principles of our faith, such as Divine Providence, reward and punishment, and also doubts about the authenticity of the Torah and the Prophets.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 96

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/96](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/96)


וְעַל כֻּלָּם אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת. סְלַח לָֽנוּ. מְחַל לָֽנוּ. כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ:


And for all of these, God of pardon, pardon us, forgive us, grant us atonement.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 97

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/97](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/97)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹלָה:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a burnt-offering.⁹⁷

footnotes:
⁹⁷ A burnt-offering is brought for failure to fulfill any positive commandment, e.g, putting on non-kosher tefillin.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 98

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/98](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/98)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם חַטָּאת:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a sin-offering.⁹⁸

footnotes:
⁹⁸ A sin-offering is brought for unintentionally transgressing any prohibitive commandment punishable by excision (כָּרֵת) if it were done with intent.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 99

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/99](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/99)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם קָרְבַּן עוֹלֶה וְיוֹרֵד:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a “fluctuating” offering.⁹⁹

footnotes:
⁹⁹ The fluctuating offering is an offering that varies in value according to the financial means of the individual who brings it. (The literal meaning of עוֹלָה וְיוֹרֵד, is “go up and down”). This type of offering is brought when a person swore falsely (unintentionally) concerning something he did or did not do. For example, one may have thought he ate something and consequently swore that he ate it, but in reality he did not and thus he swore falsely.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 100

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/100](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/100)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם אָשָׁם וַדַּאי וְתָלוּי:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a guilt-offering for certain or for doubtful trespasses.¹⁰⁰

footnotes:
¹⁰⁰ This type of sacrifice was brought in an instance where it is uncertain whether or not a violation occurred. For example it is not known whether a substance he ate was of a forbidden nature or if it was permitted.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 101

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/101](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/101)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם מַכַּת מַרְדּוּת:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of lashing for violations of Rabbinic law.¹⁰¹

footnotes:
¹⁰¹ A Rabbinic Court had the right to impose lashing for a violation of a rabbinic injunction.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 102

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/102](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/102)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם מַלְקוּת אַרְבָּעִים:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of forty lashes.¹⁰²

footnotes:
¹⁰² Forty lashes proscribed by the Torah was given to one who actively and intentionally violated any of the prohibitive commandments, providing he was forewarned and the act was witnessed by two witnesses.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 103

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/103](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/103)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם מִיתָה בִּידֵי שָׁמָֽיִם:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of death at the hand of Heaven.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 104

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/104](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/104)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם כָּרֵת וַעֲרִירִי:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of excision and childlessness.¹⁰³

footnotes:
¹⁰³ One who intentionally does work or eats on Yom Kippur, or one who eats chometz — leavened bread — on Pesach, is punished with excision and childlessness.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 105

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/105](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/105)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם אַרְבַּע מִיתוֹת בֵּית דִּין. סְקִילָה. שְׂרֵפָה. הֶֽרֶג. וְחֶֽנֶק.


And for sins for which we are liable to any of the four death penalties inflicted by the [Rabbinic] Court [which are]: stoning, burning, beheading or strangulation.¹⁰⁴

footnotes:
¹⁰⁴ Stoning is the penalty for knowingly desecrating Shabbos, burning is the penalty for certain forbidden sexual relationships, beheading is the penalty for murder, and strangulation is the penalty for adultery.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 106

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/106](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/106)


עַל מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה וְעַל מִצְוַת לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה. בֵּין שֶׁיֶּשׁ בָּהּ קוּם עֲשֵׂה. וּבֵין שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ קוּם עֲשֵׂה. אֶת הַגְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ וְאֶת שֶׁאֵינָם גְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ. אֶת הַגְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ כְּבָר אֲמַרְנוּם לְפָנֶֽיךָ. וְהוֹדִֽינוּ לְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם. וְאֶת שֶׁאֵינָם גְּלוּיִם לָֽנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ הֵם גְּלוּיִים וִידוּעִים. כַּדָּבָר שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר הַנִּסְתָּרֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ. וְהַנִּגְלֹת לָֽנוּ וּלְבָנֵֽינוּ עַד עוֹלָם. לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת: כִּי אַתָּה סָלְחָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וּמָחֳלָן לְשִׁבְטֵי יְשֻׁרוּן בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר וּמִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה:


For [transgressing] positive commandments, and for [transgressing] prohibitive commandments, whether the prohibition can be corrected by a specifically prescribed act,¹⁰⁵ or whether it cannot be corrected by a specifically prescribed act, for those of which we are aware and for those of which we are not aware. For those of which we are aware, we have already declared before You and confessed them unto You; and those of which we are not aware, before You they are revealed and known, as it is said, “The hidden things belong to Adonoy, our God, but the revealed things are for us and for our children forever, that we might fulfill all the words of this Torah.”¹⁰⁶ For You are the Pardoner of Yisrael, and the Forgiver of the tribes of Yeshurun in every generation, and beside You, we have no King Who forgives and pardons—only You!

footnotes:
¹⁰⁵ For example returning the stolen money would be a corrective measure for the prohibition of stealing.
¹⁰⁶ Devorim 29:28.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 107

אֱלֹהַי. עַד שֶׁלֹּא נוֹצַֽרְתִּי אֵינִי כְדַאי, וְעַכְשָׁו שֶׁנּוֹצַֽרְתִּי כְּאִלּוּ לֹא נוֹצַֽרְתִּי. עָפָר אֲנִי בְּחַיָּי. קַל וָחֹֽמֶר בְּמִיתָתִי. הֲרֵי אֲנִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ כִּכְלִי מָלֵא בוּשָׁה וּכְלִמָּה.


God, before I was formed, I was unworthy [to be created]. And now that I have been formed, it is as if I had not been formed. I am like dust while I live, how much more so when I am dead. Here I am before You like a vessel filled with shame.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 108

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/108](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/108)


יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי שֶׁלֹּא אֶחֱטָא עוֹד. וּמַה שֶּׁחָטָֽאתִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ מָרֵק בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים. אֲבָל לֹא עַל יְדֵי יִסּוּרִים וָחֳלָיִם רָעִים:


May it be Your will, Adonoy, my God, and the God of my fathers, that I shall sin no more, and the sins I have committed before You, cleanse them in Your abundant mercies; but not through suffering and severe illness.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 109

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/109](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/109)


אֱלֹהַי נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ תִּרְדּוֹף נַפְשִׁי וְכֹל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם: עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן יְמִינֶֽךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶֽךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ. לְמַֽעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶֽיךָ הוֹשִֽׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵֽנִי:


My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceitfully. To those who curse me, may my soul be unresponsive; and let my soul be like dust to all. Open my heart to Your Torah and let my soul pursue Your commandments. And all who plan evil against me, quickly annul their counsel and frustrate their intention. Act for the sake of Your Name. Act for the sake of Your right hand. Act for the sake of Your holiness. Act for the sake of Your Torah. In order that Your loved ones be released, deliver [with] Your right hand and answer me.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 110

יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:


May the words of my mouth be acceptable and the thoughts of my heart — before You Adonoy, my Rock and my Redeemer.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 111

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/111](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/111)


עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:


He Who makes the peace in His high heavens may He make peace upon us and upon all Yisrael and say Amein.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Amidah 112

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/112](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Amidah/r/112)


יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ: וְשָׁם נַעֲבָדְךָ בְּיִרְאָה כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִיּוֹת: וְעָרְבָה לַיהֹוָה מִנְחַת יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלָֽםִ כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִיּוֹת:


May it be Your will, Adonoy, our God, and the God of our Fathers that the Holy Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our share in Your Torah. And there we will serve You reverently as in the days of old, and in earlier years. And let Adonoy be pleased with the offerings of Yehudah and Yerushalayim as in the days of old and in earlier years.



### Vayechulu

###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Vayechulu 2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Vayechulu/r/2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Vayechulu/r/2)


**וַיְכֻלּוּ**הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וְהָאָֽרֶץ וְכָל־צְבָאָם: וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה. וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה: וַיְבָֽרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ. כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת:


**The heavens** and the earth were completed and [so were] all their hosts. And God completed by the seventh day His work which He had done, and He abstained on the seventh day, from all His work which He had done. And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it for on it He abstained from all His work which God had created to do.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Vayechulu 4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Vayechulu/r/4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Vayechulu/r/4)


**חזן: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה** אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא. אֵל עֶלְיוֹן קוֹנֵה שָׁמַֽיִם וָאָֽרֶץ:


Blessed are You, Adonoy, our God and God of our fathers, God of Avraham, God of Yitzchak, and God of Yaakov; the Almighty, the Great, the Powerful, the Awesome, the most high Almighty, Possessor of heaven and earth.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Vayechulu 6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Vayechulu/r/6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Vayechulu/r/6)


מָגֵן אָבוֹת בִּדְבָרוֹ. מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּמַאֲמָרוֹ. הַמֶּלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁאֵין כָּמֽוֹהוּ. הַמֵּנִֽיחַ לְעַמּוֹ בְּיוֹם שַׁבַּת קָדְשׁוֹ. כִּי בָם רָצָה לְהָנִֽיחַ לָהֶם. לְפָנָיו נַעֲבוֹד בְּיִרְאָה וָפַֽחַד. וְנוֹדֶה לִשְׁמוֹ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מֵעֵין הַבְּרָכוֹת: אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת. אֲדוֹן הַשָּׁלוֹם. מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת וּמְבָרֵךְ שְׁבִיעִי. וּמֵנִֽיחַ בִּקְדֻשָּׁה לְעַם מְדֻשְּׁנֵי עֹֽנֶג זֵֽכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית:


Shield of [our] fathers with His word, Resurrector of the dead with His utterance; the King, the Holy One Who has no peer. He gives rest to His people on the day of His holy Shabbos for with them He was pleased to grant them rest. Before Him we will serve with fear and trepidation, and give thanks to His Name every day continuously, from the essence of the blessings. Almighty of thanksgiving, Master of peace, Sanctifier of the Shabbos, Who blesses the seventh day and grants rest in sanctity to a people sated with delight— in commemoration of the work of creation.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Vayechulu 7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Vayechulu/r/7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Vayechulu/r/7)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ רְצֵה נָא בִמְנוּחָתֵֽנוּ. קַדְּשֵֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְו‍ֹתֶֽיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ שַׂבְּעֵֽנוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ. וְשַׂמְּחֵֽנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ: וְטַהֵר לִבֵּֽנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת. וְהַנְחִילֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ. וְיָנֽוּחוּ בָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶֽךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת:


Our God, and God of our fathers, be pleased with our rest, sanctify us with Your commandments and give us our share in Your Torah; satisfy us from Your goodness and gladden us with Your deliverance, and purify our hearts to serve You in truth. And give us as our inheritance, Adonoy our God, in love and in pleasure Your holy Shabbos; and may Yisrael rest thereon— the sanctifiers of Your Name. Blessed are You Adonoy, Sanctifier of Shabbos.



### Yaaleh

###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/3)


**יַעֲלֶה**תַחֲנוּנֵֽנוּ מֵעֶֽרֶב. וְיָבֹא שַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ מִבֹּֽקֶר. וְיֵרָאֶה רִנּוּנֵֽנוּ עַד עָֽרֶב:


**May** our supplication ascend¹ from the evening,² and may our cry come¹ from the morning, and may our song appear¹ till evening.³

¹ Before the throne of Your glory.
² The eve of Yom Kippur.
¹ Before the throne of Your glory.
¹ Before the throne of Your glory.
³ The close of Yom Kippur.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 4

יַעֲלֶה קוֹלֵֽנוּ מֵעֶֽרֶב. וְיָבֹא צִדְקָתֵֽנוּ מִבֹּֽקֶר. וְיֵרָאֶה פִדְיוֹנֵֽנוּ עַד עָֽרֶב:


May our voice ascend from the evening, and may our righteousness come from the morning, and may our redemption appear till evening.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 5
