אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ. סְלַח לָֽנוּ. מְחַל לָֽנוּ. כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ:


Our God, and God of our fathers! Pardon us, forgive us, atone for us.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 100

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/100](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/100)


כִּי אָֽנוּ עַמֶּֽךָ וְאַתָּה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ. אָֽנוּ בָנֶֽיךָ וְאַתָּה אָבִֽינוּ: אָֽנוּ עֲבָדֶֽיךָ וְאַתָּה אֲדוֹנֵֽנוּ. אָֽנוּ קְהָלֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה חֶלְקֵֽנוּ: אָֽנוּ נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה גוֹרָלֵֽנוּ. אָֽנוּ צֹאנֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה רוֹעֵֽנוּ: אָֽנוּ כַרְמֶּֽךָ וְאַתָּה נוֹטְרֵֽנוּ. אָֽנוּ פְעֻלָּתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ: אָֽנוּ רַעְיָתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה דוֹדֵֽנוּ. אָֽנוּ סְגֻלָּתֶֽךָ וְאַתָּה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ. אָֽנוּ עַמֶּֽךָ וְאַתָּה מַלְכֵּֽנוּ: אָֽנוּ מַאֲמִירֶֽיךָ וְאַתָּה מַאֲמִירֵֽנוּ:


For we are Your people; and You are our God. We are Your children; and You are our Father. We are Your servants; and You are our Master. We are Your congregation; and You are our Portion. We are Your inheritance; and You are our Destiny. We are Your flock; and You are our Shepherd. We are Your vineyard; and You are our Keeper. We are Your work; and You are our Creator. We are Your dear ones and You are our Beloved. We are Your treasure; and You are our God. We are Your people; and You are our King. We are Your distinguished ones; and You are our Distinction.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 101

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/101](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/101)


אָֽנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וְאַתָּה רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן. אָֽנוּ קְשֵׁי עֹֽרֶף וְאַתָּה אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם. אָֽנוּ מְלֵאֵי עָו‍ֹן וְאַתָּה מָלֵא רַחֲמִים. אָֽנוּ יָמֵֽינוּ כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר וְאַתָּה הוּא וּשְׁנוֹתֶֽיךָ לֹא יִתָּֽמּוּ:


We are brazen-faced; and You are merciful and gracious. We are stiff-necked; and You are slow to anger. We are full of iniquity; and You are full of compassion. Our days are like a passing shadow; and You are the same and Your years will not end.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 102

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/102](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/102)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ תָּבֹא לְפָנֶֽיךָ תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ, וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתֵֽנוּ שֶׁאֵין אֲנַֽחְנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וּקְשֵׁי עֹֽרֶף לוֹמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ צַדִּיקִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְלֹא חָטָֽאנוּ אֲבָל אֲנַֽחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ חָטָֽאנוּ:


Our God and God of our fathers, let our prayer come before you and do not ignore our supplication. For we are not so brazen-faced and stiff-necked to say to you, Adonoy, our God, and God of our fathers, “We are righteous and have not sinned.” But, indeed, we and our fathers have sinned.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 103

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/103](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/103)


אָשַֽׁמְנוּ. בָּגַֽדְנוּ. גָּזַֽלְנוּ. דִּבַּֽרְנוּ דֹּֽפִי. הֶעֱוִֽינוּ. וְהִרְשַֽׁעְנוּ. זַֽדְנוּ. חָמַֽסְנוּ. טָפַֽלְנוּ שֶֽׁקֶר. יָעַֽצְנוּ רָע. כִּזַּֽבְנוּ. לַֽצְנוּ. מָרַֽדְנוּ. נִאַֽצְנוּ. סָרַֽרְנוּ. עָוִֽינוּ. פָּשַֽׁעְנוּ. צָרַֽרְנוּ. קִשִּֽׁינוּ עֹֽרֶף. רָשַֽׁעְנוּ. שִׁחַֽתְנוּ. תִּעַֽבְנוּ. תָּעִֽינוּ. תִּעְתָּֽעְנוּ:


We have trespassed [against God and man, and we are devastated by our guilt]; We have betrayed [God and man, we have been ungrateful for the good done to us]; We have stolen; We have slandered. We have caused others to sin; We have caused others to commit sins for which they are called רְשָׁעִים, wicked; We have sinned with malicious intent; We have forcibly taken others' possessions even though we paid for them; We have added falsehood upon falsehood; We have joined with evil individuals or groups; We have given harmful advice; We have deceived; we have mocked; We have rebelled against God and His Torah; We have caused God to be angry with us; We have turned away from God's Torah; We have sinned deliberately; We have been negligent in our performance of the commandments; We have caused our friends grief; We have been stiff-necked, refusing to admit that our suffering is caused by our own sins. We have committed sins for which we are called רָשָׁע, [raising a hand to hit someone]. We have committed sins which are the result of moral corruption; We have committed sins which the Torah refers to as abominations; We have gone astray; We have led others astray.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 104

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/104](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/104)


סַֽרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ הַטּוֹבִים וְלֹא שָֽׁוָה לָֽנוּ. וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל הַבָּא עָלֵֽינוּ. כִּי אֱמֶת עָשִֽׂיתָ וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ:


We have turned away from Your commandments and from Your good laws, and we have gained nothing from it. And You are the Righteous One in all [punishment] that has come upon us; for You have acted truthfully and we have acted wickedly.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 105

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/105](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/105)


הִרְשַֽׁעְנוּ וּפָשַֽׁעְנוּ לָכֵן לֹא נוֹשָֽׁעְנוּ, וְתֵן בְּלִבֵּֽנוּ לַעֲזוֹב דֶּֽרֶךְ יֶֽשַׁע, וְחִישׁ לָֽנוּ יֶֽשַׁע, כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ יַעֲזוֹב רָשָׁע דַרְכּוֹ וְאִישׁ אָֽוֶן מַחְשְׁבוֹתָיו וְיָשׁוֹב אֶל יְהוָֹה וִירַחֲמֵֽהוּ וְאֶל אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ כִּי יַרְבֶּה לִסְלֽוֹחַ:


We have acted wickedly and have transgressed; we have therefore not been delivered. Grant that our hearts [be inspired to] abandon the path of wickedness, and hasten our deliverance; as is written by the hand of Your prophet, “Let the wicked man abandon his way, and the man of iniquity his thoughts; and let him return unto Adonoy, and He will have compassion on him, and unto our God for He pardons abundantly.”


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 106

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/106](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/106)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ. סְלַח וּמְחַל לַעֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ (בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וּ) בְּיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים הַזֶּה. וְהֵעָֽתֶר לָֽנוּ בִּתְפִלָּתֵֽנוּ. מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ. וְכֹף אֶת יִצְרֵֽנוּ לְהִשְׁתַּעְבֶּד לָֽךְ. וְהַכְנַע אֶת עָרְפֵּֽנוּ לָשׁוּב אֵלֶֽיךָ בֶּאֱמֶת. וְחַדֵּשׁ כִּלְיוֹתֵֽינוּ לִשְׁמֹר פִּקֻּדֶֽיךָ. וּמוֹל אֶת לְבָבֵֽנוּ לְאַהֲבָה וּלְיִרְאָה אֶת־שְׁמֶֽךָ. כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ. וּמָל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ אֶת לְבָבְךָ וְאֶת לְבַב זַרְעֶֽךָ לְאַהֲבָה אֶת יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ בְּכָל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל נַפְשְׁךָ לְמַֽעַן חַיֶּֽיךָ:


Our God, and God of our fathers! Forgive and pardon our iniquities 
*On Shabbos say:*
 (on this Shabbos day, and) on this Day of Atonement, and permit Yourself to be petitioned by our prayer. Blot out and remove our transgressions and sins from before Your eyes, and compel our Evil Inclination to be subservient to You, and subdue our stubborness, that we may return to You in truth; and renew our conscience that we may preserve Your precepts. Open our hearts that we may love and fear Your Name, as it is written in Your Torah: “And Adonoy, Your God will open Your heart, and the heart of your descendants to love Adonoy, your God, with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.”


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 107

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/107](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/107)


הַזְּדוֹנוֹת וְהַשְּׁגָגוֹת אַתָּה מַכִּיר הָרָצוֹן וְהָאֹֽנֶס. הַגְּלוּיִים וְהַנִּסְתָּרִים לְפָנֶֽיךָ הֵם גְּלוּיִים וִידוּעִים. מָה אָֽנוּ. מֶה חַיֵּֽינוּ. מֶה חַסְדֵּֽנוּ. מַה צִּדְקוֹתֵֽינוּ. מַה יְּשֻׁעָתֵֽנוּ. מַה כֹּחֵֽנוּ. מַה גְּבוּרָתֵֽנוּ. מַה נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבֹתֵֽינוּ הֲלֹא כָּל הַגִּבּוֹרִים כְּאַֽיִן לְפָנֶֽיךָ וְאַנְשֵׁי הַשֵּׁם כְּלֹא הָיוּ וַחֲכָמִים כִּבְלִי מַדָּע וּנְבוֹנִים כִּבְלִי הַשְׂכֵּל כִּי רֹב מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם תֹּֽהוּ וִימֵי חַיֵּיהֶם הֶֽבֶל לְפָנֶֽיךָ. וּמוֹתַר הָאָדָם מִן הַבְּהֵמָה אָֽיִן כִּי הַכֹּל הָֽבֶל:


Our intentional and our unintentional sins— You recognize— [those committed] willfully or by compulsion, [those committed] openly or secretly— before Your Presence, they are [all] revealed and known. What are we? What is our life? What are our acts of kindness? What is our righteousness? What is our deliverance? What is our strength? What is our might? What can we say before You, Adonoy, our God and God of our fathers? Are not all the mighty men as nothing before You? Famous men as though they had never been? The wise as if they were without knowledge? And men of understanding as if they were devoid of intelligence? For most of their actions are a waste and the days of their life are trivial in Your presence. The superiority of man over beast is nil for all is futile.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 108

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/108](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/108)


מַה נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יוֹשֵׁב מָרוֹם. וּמַה נְּסַפֵּר לְפָנֶֽיךָ שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים. הֲלֹא כָּל הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת וְהַנִּגְלוֹת אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ:


What shall we say before You, Who dwells on high; and what shall we relate to You Who dwells in the heavens? For everything, both hidden and revealed, You know.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 109

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/109](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/109)


אַתָּה מֵבִין תַּעֲלוּמוֹת לֵב. אֶֽפֶס לְךָ נִגְלוֹת וְגַם נִסְתָּרוֹת: בָּֽאנוּ בִדְבָרִים לְפַתּוֹתְךָ בָם. בְּרִשְׁעֵֽנוּ אַל תֵּֽפֶן וְלֹא בְמַעֲלָלֵֽינוּ: גִּשְׁתֵּֽנוּ בְּיוֹם כְּיָרֵא וְחָרֵד. גֵּאֶה כְּרַחוּם לְמַעַנְךָ עֲשֵׂה חָֽסֶד: דִּין אַל תִּמְתַּח מוּל עָפָר וָאֵֽפֶר. דַּע אַחֲרִיתֵֽנוּ רִמָּה וְתוֹלֵעָה: הַאִם שָׁגַֽגְנוּ וְנֶעְלַם מִמֶּֽנּוּ. הֲלֹא אַתָּה לְבַד מֵבִין שְׁגִיאוֹת: וְאַל תַּחֲשָׁב לָֽנוּ כְּעוֹשֶׂה בְּזָדוֹן. וִדּוּי שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ שְׁעֵה בְּעֵת רָצוֹן: זֶה כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ הוֹדַע וְלֹא הוֹדַע. זָדוֹן וְנֶעְלָם עֲשֵׂה וְלֹא תַעֲשֶׂה: חַלְּצֵֽנוּ מֵעֹֽנֶשׁ כָּרֵת וּמִיתָה. חֲמוֹל עַל חֹֽמֶר מַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶֽיךָ: טָפַֽשְׁנוּ בְּרֹֽעַ יֵֽצֶר אֲשֶׁר מִנְּעוּרֵֽינוּ. טָמוּן בְּקִרְבֵּֽנוּ כְּרֶֽשֶׁת לִפְעָמֵֽינוּ: יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ וְעוֹשֵֽׂנוּ יוֹדֵֽעַ יִצְרֵֽנוּ. יֶהֱמוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וְאַל תַּשְׁחִיתֵֽנוּ: כִּי מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ מִי יִסָּתֵר. כֹּל גָּלוּי לְךָ כָּאוֹר וְכַצָּהֳרָֽיִם: לְבֵית דִּין הוֹרֵיתָ אַרְבַּע מִיתוֹת. לְמַעַנְךָ עֲשֵׂה וּמֵהֶם חַלְּצֵֽנוּ: מֵאָז יְצַרְתָּֽנוּ חֲקַרְתָּֽנוּ וַתֵּדַע. מַעֲשֵֽׂינוּ כִּי הֵמָּה עָמָל וָאָֽוֶן: נְצֹר נַפְשׁוֹתֵֽינוּ כִּי בְיָדְךָ כָּל נֶֽפֶשׁ. נָא תִּיקַר נֶֽפֶשׁ מִמְּעַנֵּי לְךָ נָֽפֶשׁ: סְקִילָה שְׂרֵפָה הֶֽרֶג וְחֶֽנֶק. סוֹדָם גִּלִּֽיתָ לְיוֹדְעֵי אֲמִתֶּֽךָ: עַל כָּל פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ אֱלֽוֹהַּ כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ. עַל יָדֽוּעַ לָֽנוּ וְעַל נֶעְלָם מִמֶּֽנוּ: פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ הוֹדִֽינוּ לְךָ חוֹקֵר לֵב. פְּדֵֽנוּ מֵחֵטְא נַקֵּֽנוּ מֵעָו‍ֹן: צוּר אַל תֵּֽפֶן בֶּאֱנוֹשׁ חָצִיר. צְדָקָה עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ כְּעָשִֽׂיתָ עִם כָּל חָי: קִדַּֽמְנוּ בַנֶּֽשֶׁף קָרַֽבְנוּ בְשֶֽׁוַע. קָרַֽבְנוּ אֵלֶֽיךָ קְשֹׁב קְרִיאָתֵֽנוּ: רִשְׁעֵֽנוּ אַל תֵּֽפֶן רַחֲמֵֽנוּ וְנִצְטַדְּקָה. רַחֲמֶֽיךָ יְבֹאֽוּנוּ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן:


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 110

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/110](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/110)


**שִׁמְךָ**מֵעוֹלָם עוֹבֵר עַל פֶּֽשַׁע. שַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ תַאֲזִין בְּעָמְדֵֽנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּתְפִלָּה: תַּעֲבֹר עַל פֶּֽשַׁע לְעַם שָֽׁבֵי פֶֽשַׁע. תִּמְחֶה פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ:


**Your Name** was always the “forbearer of transgression,” give ear to our plea as we stand before You in prayer. Forbear the transgression of a people who repent [their] transgression; blot out our transgression from before Your eyes.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 111

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/111](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/111)


אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ רָזֵי עוֹלָם. וְתַעֲלוּמוֹת סִתְרֵי כָל חָי: אַתָּה חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן וּבוֹחֵן כְּלָיוֹת וָלֵב: אֵין דָּבָר נֶעְלָם מִמֶּֽךָּ. וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ: וּבְכֵן יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ. שֶׁתְּכַפֵּר לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ. וְתִסְלַח לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל עֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ. וּתִמְחָל לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ:


You know the mysteries of the universe, and the hidden secrets of every individual. You search all our innermost thoughts,⁷⁸ and probe our mind⁷⁹ and heart. There is nothing hidden from You, and there is nothing concealed from Your sight. And so may it be Your will Adonoy our God and God of our fathers, that You pardon us for all our careless sins, and that You forgive us for all our deliberate sins, and that You grant us atonement for all our rebellious sins:

footnotes:
⁷⁸ The literal meaning of חַדְרֵי בָטֶן is “chambers of the stomach,” but according to Ibn Ezra to Mishlei 20:27, from which the expression is taken, חַדְרֵי בָטֶן refers to the heart which is the innermost chamber of human thought.
⁷⁹ The literal meaning of כְּלָיוֹת is “kidneys,” which are said to give counsel to the heart.— Avudraham


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 112

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/112](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/112)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאֹֽנֶס וּבְרָצוֹן:


For the sin we committed before You under compulsion⁸⁰ and willingly.

footnotes:
⁸⁰ Even a sin committed under duress needs to be forgiven, because many times a person allows himself to be placed in a predicament in which he is compelled to sin (e.g., leaving the office at a very late hour on the eve of Shabbos or Festival).—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 113

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/113](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/113)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאִמּוּץ הַלֵּב:


And for the sin we committed before You by callously hardening the heart.⁸¹

footnotes:
⁸¹ This would include not giving charity with a whole heart, and not helping a needy fellow Jew.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 114

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/114](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/114)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּבְלִי דָֽעַת:


For the sin we committed before You inadvertently.⁸²

footnotes:
⁸² The literal meaning of בִּבְלִי דַעַת is “without knowledge,” and it implies not using our intellectual capabilities to study the laws of Torah and therewith gain the “knowledge” needed to observe the commandments properly.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 115

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/115](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/115)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּבִטּוּי שְׂפָתָֽיִם:


And for the sin we committed before You with an utterance of the lips.⁸³

footnotes:
⁸³ This includes the sins of making vows and oaths (even though they are kept), verbally insulting one’s fellowmen, and directing one’s displeasure against the decrees of Hashem.— Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 116

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/116](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/116)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּגָלוּי וּבַסָּֽתֶר:


For the sin we committed before You openly and secretly.⁸⁴

footnotes:
⁸⁴ A sin committed publicly could very well cause חִלוּל ה', the desecration of Hashem’s Name, and may also lead others to sin. A sin committed in secret, indicates that the sinner fears the reaction of people but is unafraid of Hashem’s displeasure.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 117

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/117](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/117)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּגִלּוּי עֲרָיוֹת:


And for the sin we committed before You in sexual immorality.⁸⁵

footnotes:
⁸⁵ This also includes such things that arouse desire for forbidden sexual relationships, such as embracing or dancing.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 118

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/118](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/118)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּדִבּוּר פֶּה:


For the sin we committed before You through [misuse of our power of] speech.⁸⁶

footnotes:
⁸⁶ This includes speaking the words of Torah in unclean places, cursing, humiliating someone; speaking of business matters on Shabbos, revealing another person’s secret, telling jokes and holding idle conversations in a house of worship (and certainly during the actual prayers) and telling lies.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 119

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/119](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/119)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּדַעַת וּבְמִרְמָה:


And for the sin we committed before You with knowledge and with deceit.⁸⁷

footnotes:
⁸⁷ This includes false advertising and dishonesty in business matters.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 120

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/120](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/120)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּהַרְהוֹר הַלֵּב:


For the sin we committed before You by improper thoughts.⁸⁸

footnotes:
⁸⁸ Evil thoughts, lustful thoughts, heretical thoughts, and suspicious thoughts about righteous people are included.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 121

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/121](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/121)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּהוֹנָֽאַת רֵֽעַ:


And for the sin we committed before You by cheating a fellow-man.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 122

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/122](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/122)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּוִדּוּי פֶּה:


For the sin we committed before You with [mere] verbal confession.⁸⁹

footnotes:
⁸⁹ This refers to confession of sins without feeling regret for committing them and without earnest resolve to correct them in the future.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 123

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/123](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/123)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּוְעִידַת זְנוּת:


And for the sin we committed before You by joining in a lewd gathering.⁹⁰

footnotes:
⁹⁰ Any gathering or intimate meeting for the purpose of sexual immortality is included.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 124

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/124](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/124)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּזָדוֹן וּבִשְׁגָגָה:


For the sin we committed before You intentionally and unintentionally.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 125

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/125](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/125)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּזִלְזוּל הוֹרִים וּמוֹרִים:


And for the sin we committed before You by insufficient respect for parents and teachers.⁹¹

footnotes:
⁹¹ Not obeying their commands, not rising for a talmudic scholar and disrespect for one’s teacher even if he is not considered a “Torah Great” are included.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 126

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/126](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/126)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּחֹֽזֶק יָד:


For the sin we committed before You by using coercion [to harm others].⁹²

footnotes:
⁹² This includes using physical, political or financial power to harm someone.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 127

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/127](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/127)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּחִלּוּל הַשֵּׁם:


And for the sin we committed before You by desecrating the Divine Name.⁹³

footnotes:
⁹³ This involves any sin committed that becomes public knowledge, including improper conduct with one’s fellow man.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 128

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/128](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/128)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּטִפְשׁוּת פֶּה:


For the sin we committed before You with foolish talk.⁹⁴

footnotes:
⁹⁴ This refers to idle talk and gossip.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 129

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/129](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/129)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּטֻמְאַת שְׂפָתָֽיִם:


And for the sin we committed before You with impurity of the lips.⁹⁵

footnotes:
⁹⁵ This includes profanity and unclean language.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 130

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/130](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/130)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּיֵֽצֶר הָרָע:


For the sin we committed before You with the Evil Inclination.⁹⁶

footnotes:
⁹⁶ When a person allows his Evil Inclination to rule over him, he commits a sin.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 131

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/131](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/131)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּיוֹדְעִים וּבְלֹא יוֹדְעִים:


And for the sin we committed before You knowingly and unknowingly.⁹⁷

footnotes:
⁹⁷ We ask Hashem to pardon us even for sins we are not aware that we committed, and also for such sins through which we caused damage but are not aware of the amount of loss incurred.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 132

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/132](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/132)


וְעַל כֻּלָּם אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת. סְלַח לָֽנוּ. מְחַל לָֽנוּ. כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ:


And for all of these, God of pardon, pardon us, forgive us, grant us atonement.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/133](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/133)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּכַפַּת שֹֽׁחַד:


For the sin we committed before You by forcing someone to give or take bribes.⁹⁸

footnotes:
⁹⁸ A bribe is not limited to money or gifts; it includes flattery or personal favors.— Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 134

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/134](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/134)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּכַֽחַשׁ וּבְכָזָב:


And for the sin we committed before You by false denial and false promise.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 135

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/135](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/135)

For the sin we committed before You by evil talk [slander].⁹⁹

footnotes:
⁹⁹ This includes causing a fellow Jew physical, monetary of social harm through passing degrading information about him to another person. It makes no difference whether this is done in his presence or behind his back, or if the information is true or false.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 136

And for the sin we committed before You by scoffing.¹⁰⁰

footnotes:
¹⁰⁰ Ridicule of a person, a commandment, or guards of Torah are all included in the sin of scoffing.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 137

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/137](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/137)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּמַשָּׂא וּבְמַתָּן:


For the sin we committed before You in business dealings.¹⁰¹

footnotes:
¹⁰¹ This would include overcharging, misrepresenting, false-labeling and all other such deceitful practices.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 138

And for the sin we committed before You in eating and drinking.¹⁰²

footnotes:
¹⁰² Eating forbidden (non-kosher) foods, not saying the proper blessing or grace after meals, over-eating, are included in this sin.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 139

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/139](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/139)

For the sin we committed before You by [taking or giving] interest and by usury.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/140](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/140)

And for the sin we committed before You by haughtily stretching forth the neck.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/141](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/141)

For the sin we committed before You with gazing of the eyes.¹⁰³

footnotes:
¹⁰³ This refers to using the eyes to gaze at forbidden things.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 142

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/142](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/142)

And for the sin we committed before You by the prattle of our lips.¹⁰⁴

footnotes:
¹⁰⁴ This includes idle gossip, which is certainly forbidden in the synagogue at all times.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 143

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/143](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/143)

For the sin we committed before You with haughty eyes.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 144

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/144](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/144)

And for the sin we committed before You with impudence.¹⁰⁵

footnotes:
¹⁰⁵ Speaking “with chutzpah” to Torah scholars, or to someone more learned than himself is included in עַזּוּת מֵצַח.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 145

וְעַל כֻּלָּם אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת. סְלַח לָֽנוּ. מְחַל לָֽנוּ. כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ:


And for all of these, God of pardon, pardon us, forgive us, grant us atonement.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 146

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/146](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/146)

For the sin we committed before You by throwing off the yoke [of heaven].¹⁰⁶

footnotes:
¹⁰⁶ Rejecting an obligation to fulfill even a single commandment. Also included is shirking a religious obligation which must then be assumed by someone else.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 147

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/147](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/147)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּפְלִילוּת:


And for the sin we committed before You in passing judgment.¹⁰⁷

footnotes:
¹⁰⁷ This includes a “Dayan,” a judge who does not render correct decisions, and it also includes not giving someone the benefit of the doubt.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 148

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/148](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/148)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּצְדִיַּת רֵֽעַ:


For the sin we committed before You by entrapping a fellowman.¹⁰⁸

footnotes:
¹⁰⁸ This includes even attempting to harm someone; even if no harm was actually done, he still needs forgiveness.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 149

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/149](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/149)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּצָרוּת עָֽיִן:


And for the sin we committed before You by a begrudging eye.¹⁰⁹

footnotes:
¹⁰⁹ Not doing a favor, not giving charity properly, and feeling bad at someone else’s success are included.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 150

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/150](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/150)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּקַלּוּת רֹאשׁ:


For the sin we committed before You by lightmindedness.¹¹⁰

footnotes:
¹¹⁰ Lightmindedness or frivolity in the synagogue or Bais Midrash or while wearing tefillin are serious sins.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 151

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/151](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/151)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּקַשְׁיוּת עֹֽרֶף:


And for the sin we committed before You by being stiff-necked [stubborn].¹¹¹

footnotes:
¹¹¹ Rejecting admonition and “ignoring” punishment are included. Also included is brushing aside illness, financial loss, and humiliation as mere coincidences rather than manifestations of Divine displeasure.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 152

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/152](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/152)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּרִיצַת רַגְלַֽיִם לְהָרַע:


For the sin we committed before You by running to do evil.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 153

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/153](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/153)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּרְכִילוּת:


And for the sin we committed before You by talebearing.¹¹²

footnotes:
¹¹² This refers to carrying tales, even true ones, about one person to another, and the one who listens to these tales is also included in this category of sin.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 154

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/154](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/154)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּשְׁבֽוּעַת שָׁוְא:


For the sin we committed before You by swearing in vain.¹¹³

footnotes:
¹¹³ This includes swearing falsely or even swearing a useless oath.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 155

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/155](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/155)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּשִׂנְאַת חִנָּם:


And for the sin we committed before You by unwarranted hatred.¹¹⁴

footnotes:
¹¹⁴ Hating someone because of jealousy, or because he doesn’t conform to your ideas of ettiquete.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 156

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/156](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/156)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּתְשֽׂוּמֶת יָד:


For the sin we committed before You by breach of trust.¹¹⁵

footnotes:
¹¹⁵ Denying that you owe someone a monetary debt when he asks for payment.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 157

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/157](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/157)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּתִמְהוֹן לֵבָב:


And for the sin we committed before You by a confused heart.¹¹⁶

footnotes:
¹¹⁶ This includes sins committed because of confusion, worry or pain, it also includes the sin of harboring doubts about the authenticity of the laws enacted by our Sages, and doubts about the fundamental principles of our faith, such as Divine Providence, reward and punishment, and also doubts about the authenticity of the Torah and the Prophets.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 158

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/158](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/158)


וְעַל כֻּלָּם אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת. סְלַח לָֽנוּ. מְחַל לָֽנוּ. כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ:


And for all of these, God of pardon, pardon us, forgive us, grant us atonement.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 159

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/159](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/159)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹלָה:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a burnt-offering.¹¹⁷

footnotes:
¹¹⁷ A burnt-offering is brought for failure to fulfill any positive commandment, e.g, putting on non-kosher tefillin.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 160

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/160](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/160)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם חַטָּאת:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a sin-offering.¹¹⁸

footnotes:
¹¹⁸ A sin-offering is brought for unintentionally transgressing any prohibitive commandment punishable by excision (כָּרֵת) if it were done with intent.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 161

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/161](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/161)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם קָרְבַּן עוֹלֶה וְיוֹרֵד:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a “fluctuating” offering.¹¹⁹

footnotes:
¹¹⁹ The fluctuating offering is an offering that varies in value according to the financial means of the individual who brings it. (The literal meaning of עוֹלָה וְיוֹרֵד, is “go up and down”). This type of offering is brought when a person swore falsely (unintentionally) concerning something he did or did not do. For example, one may have thought he ate something and consequently swore that he ate it, but in reality he did not and thus he swore falsely.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 162

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/162](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/162)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם אָשָׁם וַדַּאי וְתָלוּי:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a guilt-offering for certain or for doubtful trespasses.¹²⁰

footnotes:
¹²⁰ This type of sacrifice was brought in an instance where it is uncertain whether or not a violation occurred. For example it is not known whether a substance he ate was of a forbidden nature or if it was permitted.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 163

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/163](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/163)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם מַכַּת מַרְדּוּת:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of lashing for violations of Rabbinic law.¹²¹

footnotes:
¹²¹ A Rabbinic Court had the right to impose lashing for a violation of a rabbinic injunction.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 164

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/164](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/164)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם מַלְקוּת אַרְבָּעִים:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of forty lashes.¹²²

footnotes:
¹²² Forty lashes proscribed by the Torah was given to one who actively and intentionally violated any of the prohibitive commandments, providing he was forewarned and the act was witnessed by two witnesses.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 165

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/165](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/165)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם מִיתָה בִּידֵי שָׁמָֽיִם:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of death at the hand of Heaven.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 166

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/166](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/166)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם כָּרֵת וַעֲרִירִי:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of excision and childlessness.¹²³

footnotes:
¹²³ One who intentionally does work or eats on Yom Kippur, or one who eats chometz — leavened bread — on Pesach, is punished with excision and childlessness.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 167

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/167](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/167)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם אַרְבַּע מִיתוֹת בֵּית דִּין. סְקִילָה. שְׂרֵפָה. הֶֽרֶג. וְחֶֽנֶק.


And for sins for which we are liable to any of the four death penalties inflicted by the [Rabbinic] Court [which are]: stoning, burning, beheading or strangulation.¹²⁴

footnotes:
¹²⁴ Stoning is the penalty for knowingly desecrating Shabbos, burning is the penalty for certain forbidden sexual relationships, beheading is the penalty for murder, and strangulation is the penalty for adultery.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 168

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/168](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/168)


עַל מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה וְעַל מִצְוַת לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה. בֵּין שֶׁיֶּשׁ בָּהּ קוּם עֲשֵׂה. וּבֵין שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ קוּם עֲשֵׂה. אֶת הַגְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ וְאֶת שֶׁאֵינָם גְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ. אֶת הַגְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ כְּבָר אֲמַרְנוּם לְפָנֶֽיךָ. וְהוֹדִֽינוּ לְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם. וְאֶת שֶׁאֵינָם גְּלוּיִם לָֽנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ הֵם גְּלוּיִים וִידוּעִים. כַּדָּבָר שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר הַנִּסְתָּרֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ. וְהַנִּגְלֹת לָֽנוּ וּלְבָנֵֽינוּ עַד עוֹלָם. לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת:


For [transgressing] positive commandments, and for [transgressing] prohibitive commandments, whether the prohibition can be corrected by a specifically prescribed act,¹²⁵ or whether it cannot be corrected by a specifically prescribed act, for those of which we are aware and for those of which we are not aware. For those of which we are aware, we have already declared before You and confessed them unto You; and for those of which we are not aware, before You they are revealed and known, as it is said, “The hidden things belong to Adonoy, our God, but the revealed things are for us and for our children forever, that we might fulfill all the words of this Torah.”¹²⁶

footnotes:
¹²⁵ For example returning the stolen money would be a corrective measure for the prohibition of stealing.
¹²⁶ Devorim 29:28.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 169

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/169](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/169)


וְאַתָּה רַחוּם מְקַבֵּל שָׁבִים וְעַל הַתְּשׁוּבָה מֵרֹאשׁ הִבְטַחְתָּֽנוּ וְעַל הַתְּשׁוּבָה עֵינֵֽינוּ מְיַחֲלוֹת לָךְ: וְדָוִד עַבְדְּךָ אָמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ שְׁגִיאוֹת מִי יָבִין מִנִּסְתָּרוֹת נַקֵּֽנִי. נַקֵּֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מִכָּל פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְטַהֲרֵֽנוּ מִכָּל טֻּמְאוֹתֵֽינוּ וּזְרוֹק עָלֵֽינוּ מַֽיִם טְהוֹרִים וְטַהֲרֵֽנוּ. כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ וְזָרַֽקְתִּי עֲלֵיכֶם מַֽיִם טְהוֹרִים וּטְהַרְתֶּם מִכֹּל טֻמְאוֹתֵיכֶם וּמִכָּל גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם אֲטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם:


And You, Merciful One, accept the penitent. Concerning repentance,¹²⁷ You promised us from the very beginning;¹²⁸ and because of our repentance our eyes look hopefully to You. Dovid, Your servant, said before You, “Errors—who can comprehend? From hidden [faults], cleanse me.” Cleanse us, Adonoy, our God, from all our transgressions, and purify us from all our defilement. Sprinkle clean waters on us and cleanse us, as it is written by the hand of Your prophet, “And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you will be clean; from all your defilements, and from all your idols, I will cleanse you.”¹²⁹

footnotes:
¹²⁷ This refers to the effect of repentance to achieve atonement for the penitent.
¹²⁸ This refers to the fact that Hashem accepted the repentance of Adam after he committed the sin of eating from the Tree of Knowledge.
¹²⁹ Yechezkel 36:25


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 170

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/170](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/170)


מִיכָה עַבְדְּךָ אָמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ. מִי אֵל כָּמֽוֹךָ נוֹשֵׂא עָו‍ֹן וְעוֹבֵר עַל פֶּֽשַׁע לִשְׁאֵרִית נַחֲלָתוֹ לֹא הֶחֱזִיק לָעַד אַפּוֹ כִּי חָפֵץ חֶֽסֶד הוּא: יָשׁוּב יְרַחֲמֵֽנוּ יִכְבּוֹשׁ עֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ. וְתַשְׁלִיךְ בִּמְצֻלוֹת יָם כָּל חַטֹּאתָם: וְכָל־חַטֹּאת עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל תַּשְׁלִיךְ בִּמְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִזָּכְרוּ וְלֹא יִפָּקְדוּ וְלֹא יַעֲלוּ עַל לֵב לְעוֹלָם תִּתֵּן אֱמֶת לְיַעֲקֹב חֶֽסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם אשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ מִימֵי קֶֽדֶם:


Michah, Your servant, said before You, “Who is an Almighty [God] like You? Who bears iniquity and overlooks transgression of the remnant of His inheritance; Who does not retain His anger forever, for He delights in kindliness. He will again have compassion on us, He will subdue our iniquities, and cast into the depths of the sea, all their sins. And all the sins of Your people the House of Yisrael, You will cast into a place where they will never be remembered or counted and never recalled to mind. You will grant truth to Yaakov, kindliness to Avraham, As You have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.”¹³⁰

footnotes:
¹³⁰ Michah 7:18—20


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 171

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/171](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/171)


דָּנִיֵּאל אִישׁ חֲמוּדוֹת שִׁוַּע לְפָנֶֽיךָ הַטֵּה אֱלֹהַי אָזְנְךָ וּשְׁמָע פְּקַח עֵינֶֽיךָ וּרְאֵה שׁוֹמְמוֹתֵֽינוּ וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר נִקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלֶֽיהָ כִּי לֹא עַל צִדְקוֹתֵֽינוּ אֲנַֽחְנוּ מַפִּילִים תַּחֲנוּנֵֽינוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ. כִּי עַל רַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים: אֲדֹנָי שְׁמָעָה אֲדֹנָי סְלָחָה אֲדֹנָי הַקְשִֽׁיבָה וַעֲשֵׂה אַל תְּאַחַר לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהַי כִּי שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל עִירְךָ וְעַל עַמֶּֽךָ:


Daniel, man of [Your] delight, cried to you, “Incline Your ear, my God and hear; open Your eyes and behold our desolate places and the city which is called by Your Name, for it is not on account of our righteousness that we let fall our supplications before You, but because of Your great mercy. My Master, hear! my Master, forgive! My Master, listen and take action, do not delay! For Your sake, my God, for Your Name is proclaimed over Your city and Your people.”¹³¹

¹³¹ Daniel 9:18, 19.

עֶזְרָא הַסּוֹפֵר אָמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ. אֱלֹהַי בּֽשְׁתִּי וְנִכְלַֽמְתִּי לְהָרִים אֱלֹהַי פָּנַי אֵלֶֽיךָ כִּי עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ רָֽבוּ לְמַעְלָה רֹאשׁ וְאַשְׁמָתֵֽנוּ גָדְלָה עַד לַשָּׁמָֽיִם: וְאַתָּה אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם וְרַב חֶֽסֶד וְלֹא עֲזַבְתָּם:


Ezra, the Scribe, said before You, “My God, I am [so] ashamed, and disgraced, that I cannot lift my face to You, my God, for our iniquities have risen over our heads, and our guilt has grown to the heavens.”¹³² “And You are a God of pardon, Gracious, Merciful, Slow to Anger, and abundant in kindness; and [therefore] You did not forsake them.”¹³³

¹³² Ezra 9:6
¹³³ Nechemyah 9:17

אַל תַּעַזְבֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ. וְאַל תִּטְּשֵֽׁנוּ בּוֹרְאֵֽנוּ. וְאַל תַּזְנִיחֵֽנוּ יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ וְאַל תַּֽעַשׂ עִמָּֽנוּ כָּלָה כְּחַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ. וְקַיֶּם לָֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת הַדָּבָר שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּֽנוּ בְּקַבָּלָה עַל יְדֵי יִרְמְיָה חוֹזָךְ. כָּאָמוּר בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם וּבָעֵת הַהִיא נְאֻם יְהֹוָה יְבֻקַּשׁ אֶת עֲו‍ֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ וְאֶת חַטֹּאת יְהוּדָה וְלֹא תִמְּצָאֶֽינָה. כִּי אֶסְלַח לַאֲשֶׁר אַשְׁאִיר:


Do not forsake us, our Father, do not cast us off, our Creator, do not abandon us, our Maker, do not consume us on account of our sins. Fulfill for us, Adonoy, our God, the word, You promised in the tradition by the hand of Jeremiah, Your seer as it is said, “In those days and at that time, says Adonoy, the iniquity of Yisrael will be sought, and there will be none [found], and the sins of Yehudah [will be sought] but they shall not be found; for I will pardon those whom I leave as a remnant.”¹³⁴

עַמְּךָ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ. רְעֵבֵי טוּבְךָ צְמֵאֵי חַסְדֶּֽךָ. תְּאֵבֵי יִשְׁעֶֽךָ. יַכִּֽירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ הָרַחֲמִים וְהַסְּלִיחוֹת:


Your people and Your inheritance hunger for Your goodness, thirst for Your kindness, long for Your deliverance. Let them realize and know that unto Adonoy, our God, belongs compassion and pardon.

אֵל רַחוּם שְׁמֶֽךָ. אֵל חַנּוּן שְׁמֶֽךָ. בָּֽנוּ נִקְרָא שְׁמֶֽךָ. יְהֹוָה עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ:


Merciful Almighty is Your Name, Gracious Almighty is Your Name. Upon us is Your Name called, Adonoy! act [now] for the sake of Your Name.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 176

עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן אֲמִתָּךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן בְּרִיתָךְ. עֲשֵׁה לְמַֽעַן גָּדְלָךְ וְתִפְאַרְתָּךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן דָּתָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן הוֹדָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן וִעוּדָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן זִכְרָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן חַסְדָּךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן טוּבָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן יִחוּדָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן כְּבוֹדָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן לִמּוּדָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן מַלְכוּתָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן נִצְחָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן סוֹדָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן עֻזָּךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן פְּאֵרָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן צִדְקָתָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן קְדֻשָּׁתָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן רַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁכִינָתָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן תְּהִלָּתָךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן אוֹהֲבֶֽיךָ שֹׁכְנֵי עָפָר. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן משֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן דָּוִד וּשְׁלֹמֹה. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְמוֹת הֵיכָלֶֽךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן הֲרִיסוּת מִזְבְּחֶֽךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן דַּם עֲבָדֶיךָ הַשָּׁפוּךְ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן הֲרוּגִים עַל שֵׁם קָדְשֶֽׁךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן טְבוּחִים עַל יִחוּדֶֽךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן בָּאֵי בָאֵשׁ וּבַמַּֽיִם עַל קִדּוּשׁ שְׁמֶֽךָ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן יוֹנְקֵי שָׁדַֽיִם שֶׁלֹּא חָטְאוּ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן גְּמוּלֵי חָלָב שֶׁלֹּא פָשְׁעוּ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן תִּינוֹקוֹת שֶׁל בֵּית רַבָּן. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְךָ אִם לֹא לְמַעֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ:


Act for the sake of Your truth. Act for the sake of Your covenant. Act for the sake of Your greatness and glory. Act for the sake of Your Law. Act for the sake of Your glorious majesty. Act for the sake of Your congregation. Act for the sake of Your memorial. Act for the sake of Your kindliness. Act for the sake of Your goodness. Act for the sake of Your Unity. Act for the sake of Your honor. Act for the sake of Your teaching. Act for the sake of Your Kingship. Act for the sake of Your eternity. Act for the sake of Your counsel. Act for the sake of Your strength. Act for the sake of Your magnificence. Act for the sake of Your righteousness. Act for the sake of Your holiness. Act for the sake of Your abundant mercy. Act for the sake of Your Divine Presence. Act for the sake of Your praise. Act for the sake of Your beloved ones, who repose in the dust. Act for the sake of Avraham, Yitzchak, and Yaakov. Act for the sake of Moshe and Aharon. Act for the sake of Dovid and Shlomo. Act for the sake of Yerushalayim, city of Your holiness. Act for the sake of Tziyon, Dwelling Place of Your honor. Act for the sake of the desolation of Your Habitation. Act for the sake of the destruction of Your Altar. Act for the sake of the blood of Your servants that was spilled. Act for the sake of those who were slain to sanctify Your Holy Name. Act for the sake of those who were slaughtered for [proclaiming] Your Oneness. Act for the sake of those who went through fire and water to sanctify Your Name. Act for the sake of nursing-infants who have never sinned. Act for the sake of weaned-children who have never transgressed. Act for the sake of “Yeshiva”-children. Act for Your sake and not ours. Act for Your sake and deliver us.

עֲנֵנוּ יְהֹוָה עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ בּוֹרְאֵֽנוּ עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ גּוֹאֲלֵֽנוּ עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ דוֹרְשֵׁנוּ עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ הָאֵל הַנֶּאֱמָן עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ וָתִיק וְחָסִיד עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ זַךְ וְיָשָׁר עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ חַי וְקַיָּם עֲנֵֽנוּ: עֲנֵֽנוּ טוֹב וּמֵטִיב עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ יוֹדֵֽעַ יֶֽצֶר עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ כּוֹבֵשׁ כְּעָסִים עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ לוֹבֵשׁ צְדָקוֹת עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְלָכִים עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ נוֹרָא וְנִשְׂגָּב עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ סוֹלֵחַ וּמוֹחֵל עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ עוֹנֶה בְּעֵת צָרָה עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ פּוֹדֶה וּמַצִּיל עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ צַדִּיק וְיָשָׁר עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ קָרוֹב לְקוֹרְאָיו עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ שׁוֹמֵֽעַ אֶל אֶבְיוֹנִים עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ תּוֹמֵךְ תְּמִימִים עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ אֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ פַּֽחַד יִצְחָק עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ אֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב עֲנֵנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ עֶזְרַת הַשְּׁבָטִים עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ מִשְׂגַּב אִמָּהוֹת עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ קָשֶׁה לִכְעוֹס עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵנוּ רַךְ לִרְצוֹת עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ עוֹנֶה בְּעֵת רָצוֹן עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ אֲבִי יְתוֹמִים עֲנֵֽנוּ. עֲנֵֽנוּ דַיַּן אַלְמָנוֹת עֲנֵֽנוּ:


Answer us, Adonoy, answer us! Answer us, our God, answer us! Answer us, our Father, answer us. Answer us, our Creator, answer us. Answer us, our Redeemer, answer us. Answer us, our Seeker, answer us. Answer us, faithful Almighty, answer us. Answer us, steadfast and benevolent One, answer us. Answer us, pure and upright One, answer us. Answer us, living and permanent One, answer us. Answer us, good and beneficent One, answer us. Answer us, Knower of our inclination, answer us. Answer us, Suppressor of Anger, answer us. Answer us, One enrobed in righteousness, answer us. Answer us, Supreme King of kings, answer us. Answer us, awesome and exalted One, answer us. Answer us, Pardoner and Forgiver, answer us. Answer us, He Who answers in time of distress, answer us. Answer us, Redeemer and Saver, answer us. Answer us, just and upright One, answer us. Answer us, He Who is near to those who call upon Him, answer us. Answer us, merciful and gracious One, answer us. Answer us, You Who listen to the needy, answer us. Answer us, Supporter of the innocent, answer us. Answer us, God of our father, answer us. Answer us, God of Avraham, answer us. Answer us, Fear of Yitzchak, answer us. Answer us, Mighty One of Yaakov, answer us. Answer us, Helper of the Tribes, answer us. Answer us, Stronghold of the Matriarchs, answer us. Answer us, Whom it is hard to provoke, answer us. Answer us, You Who are easily reconciled, answer us. Answer us, you Who answer in a time of favor, answer us. Answer us, Father of orphans, answer us. Answer us, [Protective] Judge of widows, answer us.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 178

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/178](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/178)


מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִֽינוּ בְּהַר הַמּוֹרִיָּה הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְיִצְחָק בְּנוֹ כְּשֶׁנֶּעֱקַד עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְיַעֲקֹב בְּבֵית אֵל הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְיוֹסֵף בְּבֵית הָאֲסוּרִים הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ עַל יַם סוּף הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְמשֶׁה בְּחוֹרֵב הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְאַהֲרֹן בַּמַּחְתָּה הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְפִינְחָס בְּקוּמוֹ מִתּוֹךְ הָעֵדָה הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לִיהוֹשֻֽׁעַ בַּגִּלְגָּל הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לִשְׁמוּאֵל בַּמִּצְפָּה הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְדָוִד וּשְׁלֹמֹה בְנוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽיִם הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְאֵלִיָּֽהוּ בְּהַר הַכַּרְמֶל הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לֶאֱלִישָׁע בִּירִיחוֹ הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְיוֹנָה בִמְעֵי הַדָּגָה הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְחִזְּקִיָֽהוּ מֶֽלֶךְ יְהוּדָה בְּחָלְיוֹ, הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לַחֲנַנְיָה מִישָׁאֵל וַעֲזַרְיָה בְּתוֹךְ כִּבְשַׁן הָאֵשׁ הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְדָנִיֵּאל בְּגוֹב הָאֲרָיוֹת הוּא יַעֲנֵנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְמָרְדְּכַי וְאֶסְתֵּר בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְעֶזְרָא בַגּוֹלָה הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ: מִי שֶׁעָנָה לְכָל הַצַדִּיקִים וְהַחֲסִידִים וְהַתְּמִימִים וְהַיְשָׁרִים הוּא יַעֲנֵֽנוּ:


He Who answered our father Avraham on Mount Moriah, He will answer us. He Who answered Yitzchak, his son, when he was bound on the altar, He will answer us. He Who answered Yaakov in Beis El, He will answer us. He Who answered Yosef in prison, He will answer us. He Who answered our ancestors at the Reed Sea; He will answer us. He Who answered Moshe at Horeb,¹³⁵ He will answer us. He Who answered Aharon with the incense pan,¹³⁶ He will answer us. He Who answered Pinchos when he rose from among the congregation,¹³⁷ He will answer us. He Who answered Yehoshua at Gilgal,¹³⁸ He will answer us. He Who answered Shmuel in Mizpah,¹³⁹ He will answer us. He Who answered Dovid,¹⁴⁰ and Shlomo,¹⁴¹ his son, in Yerushalayim; He will answer us. He Who answered Elijah on Mount Carmel,¹⁴² He will answer us. He Who answered Elisha in Yericho,¹⁴³ He will answer us. He Who answered Yonah in the belly of the fish, He will answer us. He Who answered Chizkiyahu, King of Yehudah, in his illness¹⁴⁴; He will answer us. He Who answered Chananyah, Mishael and Azariah in the midst of the fiery furnace,¹⁴⁵ He will answer us. He Who answered Daniel in the lions' den,¹⁴⁶ He will answer us. He Who answered Mordechai and Esther in Shushan, the capital [city of Persia], He will answer us. He Who answered Ezra in captivity,¹⁴⁷ He will answer us. He Who answered all the righteous, the pious, the perfect and the upright, He will answer us.

###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Yaaleh 179

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/179](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Yaaleh/r/179)


רַחְמָנָא דְעָנֵי לַעֲנִיֵּי עֲנֵינָן. רַחֲמָנָא דְעָנֵי לִתְבִירֵי לִבָּא עֲנֵינָן. רַחֲמָנָא דְעָנֵי לְמַכִּיכֵי רוּחָא עֲנֵינָן. רַחֲמָנָא עֲנֵינָן. רַחֲמָנָא חוּס. רַחֲמָנָא פְּרוֹק. רַחֲמָנָא שְׁזִיב. רַחֲמָנָא רְחַם עֲלָן. הַשְׁתָּא בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב:


May the Merciful One, Who answers the poor, answer us. May the Merciful One Who answers the broken in spirit, answer us. May the Merciful One Who answers the broken-hearted, answer us. Merciful One, answer us; Merciful One, have pity; Merciful One, redeem; Merciful One, save; Merciful One, have compassion on us, now, speedily, and very soon.



### Avinu Malkenu

###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Avinu Malkenu 3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/3)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ:


Our Father, our King!¹⁴⁸ we have sinned before You.

footnotes:
¹⁴⁸ The Jewish People are referred to in Scripture as Hashem’s slaves (Vayikra 25:42), and as His children (Devorim 14:1). Thus we say to Him, “If we are Your children, we beseech You as our Father; if we are Your slaves, we implore You as our Master and King. Contrary to the view that Hashem the Father is so full of love for His children that He permits the wanton breaking of His commandments to go unpunished, Judaism knows that Hashem the King must be feared and His laws must be obeyed. There are times when a father is unable to do what he would like for his children because of physical or financial limitations. On the other hand, a king has the power to do anything for his subjects if he should so desire. We cry out to Hashem—You are our Father and You desire to help us—You are our King and You have the power to help us!


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Avinu Malkenu 4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/4)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה:


Our Father our King! we have no King except You.¹⁴⁹

footnotes:
¹⁴⁹ Despite our physical banishment and spiritual estrangement—the result of our sins—we still have none other than Hashem to guide our lives and to shape our destiny.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Avinu Malkenu 5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/5)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ:


Our Father, our King! deal with us [kindly] for the sake of Your Name.¹⁵⁰

¹⁵⁰ See Yechezkel 36.

אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חַדֵּשׁ עָלֵֽינוּ שָׁנָה טוֹבָה:


Our Father, our King! renew for us a good year.

אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ בַּטֵּל מֵעָלֵֽינוּ כָּל גְּזֵרוֹת קָשׁוֹת:

אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ בַּטֵּל מַחְשְׁבוֹת שׂוֹנְאֵֽינוּ:


Our Father, our King! annul the designs of those who hate us.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/9)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הָפֵר עֲצַת אוֹיְבֵֽינוּ:

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/10)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כַּלֵּה כָּל צַר וּמַשְׂטִין מֵעָלֵֽינוּ:


Our Father, our King! rid us of every oppressor and adversary.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Avinu Malkenu 11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/11)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ סְתוֹם פִּיּוֹת מַשְׂטִינֵֽנוּ וּמְקַטְרִיגֵֽנוּ:


Our Father, our King! close the mouths of our adversaries and our accusers.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/12)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כַּלֵּה דֶּֽבֶר וְחֶֽרֶב וְרָעָב וּשְׁבִי וּמַשְׁחִית וְעָו‍ֹן מִבְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ:


Our Father, our King! remove pestilence, sword, famine, captivity, destruction and [the burden of] iniquity from the members of Your covenant.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/13)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מְנַע מַגֵּפָה מִנַּחֲלָתֶֽךָ:


Our Father, our King! withhold the plague from Your inheritance.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Avinu Malkenu 14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/14)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ סְלַח וּמְחַל לְכָל עֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ:


Our Father, our King! forgive and pardon all our iniquities.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Avinu Malkenu 15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/15)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ:


Our Father, our King! blot out and remove our transgressions and sins from before Your eyes.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Avinu Malkenu 16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/16)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מְחוֹק בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים כָּל שִׁטְרֵי חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ:


Our Father, our King! erase in Your abundant mercy all records of our liabilities.¹⁵¹

footnotes:
¹⁵¹ Having just asked that our sins be forgiven and that our transgressions be removed from before His eyes, what are we asking for now? Our earlier pleas were for forgiveness of those sins we committed ourselves. But there are sins for which we are held accountable even though we do not commit them ourselves. One possibility is that of watching while others sin when we may have been able to prevent it. (Chazal say כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲרֵבִין זֶה לָזֶה. A guarantor is one who countersigns a debt note, undertaking to pay if the borrower defaults. Thus we ask Hashem to erase all our notes of obligation whether as borrower or guarantor. In all instances He is the Extender of credit.) Thus we beseech Hashem to erase the records of our guilt in those instances.—Siach Yitzchok


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Avinu Malkenu 17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Maariv%20Service%20for%20Yom%20Kippur%20Eve,_Avinu%20Malkenu/r/17)


אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הַחֲזִירֵֽנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶֽיךָ:


Our Father, our King! bring us back in wholehearted¹⁵² repentance before You.

footnotes:
¹⁵² Many repent out of their fear of Hashem. Others repent out of their love for Him. We beseech Hashem to bring us back in “wholehearted” repentance motivated by love, the most perfect form of penitence.—Etz Yosef


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Avinu Malkenu 18

footnotes:

אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חָנֵּֽנוּ וַעֲנֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּֽנוּ מַעֲשִׂים עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶֽסֶד וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ:


Our Father, our King! favor us and answer us for we have no accomplishments; deal with us charitably and kindly and deliver us.

**לְדָוִד**מִזְמוֹר לַיהֹוָה הָאָֽרֶץ וּמְלוֹאָהּ תֵּבֵל וְיֽשְׁבֵי בָהּ: כִּי־הוּא עַל־יַמִּים יְסָדָהּ וְעַל־נְהָרוֹת יְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ: מִי־יַעֲלֶה בְהַר־יְהֹוָה וּמִי יָקוּם בִּמְקוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ: נְקִי כַפַּֽיִם וּבַר־לֵבָב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשָׂא לַשָּׁוְא נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא נִשְׁבַּע לְמִרְמָה: יִשָּׂא בְרָכָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה וּצְדָקָה מֵאֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעוֹ: זֶה דּוֹר דּוֹרְשָׁיו מְבַקְשֵׁי פָנֶֽיךָ יַעֲקֹב סֶֽלָה: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי זֶה מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְהֹוָה עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְהֹוָה גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי הוּא זֶה מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶֽלָה:


**A Psalm** of Dovid: the earth is Adonoy's and the fullness thereof, the inhabited world and those who dwell in it. For He founded it upon the seas, and established it upon rivers. Who may ascend the mountain of Adonoy, and who may stand in the place of His holiness? The clean of hands and the pure of heart, who has not borne My soul in vain, and has not sworn deceitfully. He will bear Adonoy's blessing and righteousness from the God of his deliverance. This is the generation of those who seek Him, the seekers of Your Presence, [God of] Yaakov, selah. Lift up your heads, gates, and be uplifted [you] entranceways to eternity, so that the King of Glory may enter. Who is this King of Glory? Adonoy, strong and mighty; Adonoy, the Mighty One in battle. Lift up your heads, gates, and lift up, entranceways to eternity, so that the King of Glory may enter. Who is He, this King of Glory? Adonoy Tzevaos, He is the King of Glory, selah.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Maariv Service for Yom Kippur Eve, Avinu Malkenu 51
