אַתָּה גִבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי מְחַיֶּה מֵתִים אַתָּה רַב לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶֽסֶד מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר, מִי כָמֽוֹךָ בַּֽעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דּֽוֹמֶה לָּךְ מֶֽלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִֽיחַ יְשׁוּעָה:


You are mighty forever, my Master; You are the Resurrector of the dead the Powerful One to deliver us. Sustainer of the living with kindliness, Resurrector of the dead with great mercy, Supporter of the fallen, and Healer of the sick, and Releaser of the imprisoned, and Fulfiller of His faithfulness to those who sleep in the dust. Who is like You, Master of mighty deeds, and who can be compared to You? King Who causes death and restores life, and causes deliverance to sprout forth.

**And so,** grant that Your awe, Adonoy, our God, be upon all Your works, and Your dread upon all You have created; and [then] all [Your] works will fear You, and prostrate before You will be all [Your] created beings. And may they all form a single band to do Your will with a perfect heart. For we know Adonoy, our God that rulership is Yours, strength is in Your hand, might is in Your right hand and Your Name is awesome over all You have created.

**And so,** grant honor, Adonoy, to Your people, praise to those who fear You, good hope to those who seek You confident speech to those who yearn for You, joy to Your land, gladness to Your city, flourishing of pride to Dovid, Your servant and an array of light to the son of Yishai, Your anointed, speedily in our days.

**וּמִפְּנֵי**חֲטָאֵֽינוּ גָּלִֽינוּ מֵאַרְצֵֽנוּ וְנִתְרַחַֽקְנוּ מֵעַל אַדְמָתֵֽנוּ וְאֵין אֲנַֽחְנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲשׂוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּבֵית בְּחִירָתֶֽךָ בַּבַּֽיִת הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלָיו מִפְּנֵי הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה בְּמִקְדָּשֶֽׁךָ: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ רַחֲמָן שֶׁתָּשׁוּב וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים וְתִבְנֵֽהוּ מְהֵרָה וּתְגַדֵּל כְּבוֹדוֹ: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ גַּלֵּה כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ עָלֵֽינוּ מְהֵרָה וְהוֹפַע וְהִנָּשֵׂא עָלֵֽינוּ לְעֵינֵי כָּל חָי וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵֽינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם וּנְפוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָֽרֶץ. וַהֲבִיאֵֽנוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירְךָ בְּרִנָּה וְלִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם. וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֶת קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ תְּמִידִים כְּסִדְרָם וּמוּסָפִים כְּהִלְכָתָם:


**But because** of our sins, we were exiled from our land, and driven far away from our soil; and we are unable, and to perform our obligatory offerings in Your chosen House, in the great and holy House upon which Your Name is proclaimed, because of the hand [of violence] that was sent against Your Sanctuary. May it be Your will Adonoy, our God and God of our fathers, merciful King, to once again have compassion on us and on Your Sanctuary in Your abundant mercy; and rebuild it soon and greatly enhance its glory. Our Father, our King! reveal the glory of Your Kingship upon us soon, appear and be uplifted over us before the eyes of all living things. Bring near our scattered [people] from among the nations, and gather our dispersed from the ends of the earth. Bring us to Tziyon, Your city, with joyous song,— to Yerushalayim, House of Your Sanctuary, with everlasting joy. And there we will offer before You our obligatory sacrifices— the daily [burnt] offerings in their order, and the Musaf offerings according to their rule.

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/26)


(וּבְיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת שְׁנֵי כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים סֹֽלֶת מִנְחָה בְּלוּלָה בַשֶּׁמֶן וְנִסְכּוֹ: עֹלַת שַׁבַּת בְּשַׁבַּתּוֹ עַל עֹלַת הַתָּמִיד וְנִסְכָּהּ:)


*On Shabbos, add:*
 (“And on the Sabbath day [the offering is]: two male yearling lambs without blemish; two tenths [of an epha] of fine flour for a meal-offering, mixed with the [olive] oil, and its libation.” [This is] the burnt-offering for every Sabbath, in addition to the daily burnt-offering and its libation; [wine-offering].)


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/27)


**וּבֶעָשׂוֹר** לַחֹֽדֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִי הַזֶּה מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ יִֽהיֶה לָכֶם וְעִנִּיתֶם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם כָּל מְלָאכָה לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם עֹלָה לַיהוָֹה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹֽח פַּר בֶּן בָּקָר אֶחָד. אַֽיִל אֶחָד. כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר שְׁלשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרוֹנִים לָאָֽיִל וְעִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּֽבֶשׂ וְיַֽיִן כְּנִסְכּוֹ וּשְׁנֵי שְׂעִירִים לְכַפֵּר. וּשְׁנֵי תְמִידִים כְּהִלְכָתָם:


**And** on the tenth [day] of this seventh month, a day of holy assembly it shall be for you and you shall fast; all manner of work, you shall not do; And you shall present a burnt-offering to Adonoy for a pleasing savour— one young bullock, one ram, seven male yearling lambs without blemish, they shall be for you. And their meal-offerings and libations as stated: three tenths [of an epha of fine flour] for the bullock, two tenths for the ram, and one tenth for each lamb, and wine according to each libation; and two he goats for atonement, and the two daily burnt-offerings according to their law.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/28)


(יִשְׂמְחוּ בְמַלְכוּתְךָ שׁוֹמְרֵי שַׁבָּת וְקֽוֹרְאֵי עֹֽנֶג. עַם מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁבִיעִי. כֻּלָּם יִשְׂבְּעוּ וְיִתְעַנְּגוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ. וּבַשְּׁבִיעִי רָצִֽיתָ בּוֹ וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ חֶמְדַּת יָמִים אוֹתוֹ קָרָֽאתָ. זֵֽכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית:)


*On Shabbos, add:*
 (They will rejoice in Your Kingship— those who preserve the Sabbath— and call it a delight. The people who sanctify the seventh [day] will all be satisfied and delighted with Your goodness. And the seventh [day]— You took pleasure in it, and You hallowed it. “Most desirable of days,” You called it— a commemoration of the work of creation.)


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/29)


**אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ**וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ. מְחֹל לַעֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ (בְּיוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וּ) בְּיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים הַזֶּה. מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ. כָּאָמוּר אָנֹכִי אָנֹכִי הוּא מוֹחֶה פְשָׁעֶֽיךָ לְמַעֲנִי וְחַטֹּאתֶֽיךָ לֹא אֶזְכֹּר: וְנֶאֱמַר מָחִֽיתִי כָעָב פְּשָׁעֶֽיךָ וְכֶעָנָן חַטֹּאתֶֽיךָ שׁוּבָה אֵלַי כִּי גְאַלְתִּֽיךָ: וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי בַיּוֹם הַזֶּה יְכַפֵּר עֲלֵיכֶם לְטַהֵר אֶתְכֶם מִכֹּל חַטֹּאתֵיכֶם לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה תִּטְהָֽרוּ:


**Our God** and God of our fathers, forgive our iniquities 
*On Shabbos add:*
 (on this Shabbos day, and) on this Day of Atonement. Blot out and remove our transgressions and sins from before Your eyes, as it is said: “I, I [alone] am He Who blots out your transgressions for My own sake; and your sins, I will not recall.” And it is said, “I have swept away like a thick cloud your transgressions, and like a mist your sins; return to Me, for I have redeemed you.” And it is said, “For on this day He will make atonement for you, to cleanse you; from all your sins, before Adonoy, you will be cleansed.”


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/30)


(אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵֽנוּ) קַדְּשֵֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ שַׂבְּעֵֽנוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ וְשַׂמְּחֵֽנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ: (וְהַנְחִילֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ וְיָנֽוּחוּ בוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶֽךָ) וְטַהֵר לִבֵּֽנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת כִּי אַתָּה סָלְחָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וּמָחֳלָן לְשִׁבְטֵי יְשֻׁרוּן בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר וּמִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ לַעֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ וְלַעֲו‍ֹנוֹת עַמּוֹ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל. וּמַעֲבִיר אַשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּכָל שָׁנָה וְשָׁנָה. מֶֽלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ מְקַדֵּשׁ (הַשַּׁבָּת וְ) יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיוֹם הַכִּפֻּרִים:


*On Shabbos add:*
 (Our God and God of our fathers, be pleased with our rest) Sanctify us with Your commandments and give us our share in Your Torah; satisfy us from Your goodness and gladden us with Your deliverance, 
*On Shabbos add:*
 (And give us as our inheritance Adonoy our God with love and with pleasure Your holy Sabbath; and may Yisrael rest thereon— [they who are] sanctifiers of Your Name) and purify our hearts to serve You in truth, For You are the Pardoner of Yisrael, and the Forgiver of the tribes of Yeshurun in every generation, and beside You, we have no king who forgives and pardons, only You! Blessed are You, King Who forgives and pardons our iniquities, and the iniquities of His people, the House of Yisrael; and Who removes our trespasses each year; King over the whole earth, Sanctifier 
*On Shabbos add:*
 (of the Shabbos and) of Yisrael and the Day of Atonement.

###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/32)


**רְצֵה** יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם, וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶֽךָ וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ: וְתֶחֱזֶֽינָה עֵינֵֽינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן:


**Be pleased,** Adonoy, our God, with Your people Yisrael and their prayer; and restore the service to the Holy of Holies in Your abode, and the fire-offerings of Yisrael; and accept their prayer, lovingly and willingly. And may You always find pleasure with the service of Your people, Yisrael. And may our eyes behold Your merciful return to Tziyon. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who returns His Divine Presence to Tziyon.

###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/35)


**מוֹדִים** אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד צוּר חַיֵּֽינוּ מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ אַתָּה הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶֽךָ עַל חַיֵּֽינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶֽךָ וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵֽינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ וְעַל נִסֶּֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל יוֹם עִמָּֽנוּ וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶֽיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל עֵת, עֶֽרֶב וָבֹֽקֶר וְצָהֳרָֽיִם, הַטּוֹב כִּי לֹא כָלוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וְהַמְרַחֵם כִּי לֹא תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ, מֵעוֹלָם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ:


**We** are thankful to You that You Adonoy are our God and the God of our fathers forever; Rock of our lives, Shield of our deliverance, You are in every generation. We will give thanks to You and recount Your praise, for our lives which are committed into Your hand, and for our souls which are entrusted to You, and for Your miracles of every day with us, and for Your wonders and benefactions at all times— evening, morning and noon. (You are) The Beneficent One— for Your compassion is never withheld; And (You are) the Merciful One— for Your kindliness never ceases; we have always placed our hope in You.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/36)


**וְעַל** כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִתְרוֹמַם שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:


**And** for all the foregoing blessed and exalted be your Name, our King constantly, forever and ever.

וּכְתוֹב לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים כָּל בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ:


Inscribe for a good life all the children of Your covenant.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 39

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/39](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/39)


וְכֹל הַחַיִּים יוֹדֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה וִיהַלְלוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵֽנוּ סֶֽלָה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:


And all the living shall thank You forever and praise Your Name with sincerity the Almighty, Who is our deliverance and our help forever. Blessed are You, Adonoy, “The Beneficent” is Your Name and You it is fitting to praise.

###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 41

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/41](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/41)


**שִׂים שָׁלוֹם** טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה חֵן וָחֶֽסֶד וְרַחֲמִים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ, בָּרְכֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ כֻּלָּֽנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶֽיךָ נָתַֽתָּ לָּֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶֽסֶד וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם, וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל עֵת וּבְכָל שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ:


**Grant peace,** goodness, and blessing, favor, kindness and compassion upon us and upon all Yisrael, Your people. Bless us, our Father, all of us as one with the light of Your countenance. For by the light of Your countenance You gave us Adonoy our God, a Torah of life and the love of kindliness, righteousness, blessing, compassion, life, and peace. And may it be good in Your eyes and to bless Your people Yisrael, at all times and at every moment with Your peace.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 42

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/42](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/42)


בְּסֵֽפֶר חַיִּים בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה נִזָּכֵר וְנִכָּתֵב לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְכָל עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם:


In the book of life, blessing, peace and abundant maintenance, may we be remembered and inscribed before You; we and all Your people, the House of Yisrael for a good life and peace.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 44

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/44](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/44)


בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם: הַמְּבָרֵךְ אֶת עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם:


Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who makes the peace. 
*(others conclude—*
 Who blesses His people Yisrael with peace.)


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 45

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/45](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/45)


יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:


May the words of my mouth be acceptable and the thoughts of my heart — before You Adonoy, my Rock and my Redeemer.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 46

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/46](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/46)


אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ תָּבֹא לְפָנֶֽיךָ תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ, וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתֵֽנוּ שֶׁאֵין אֲנַֽחְנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וּקְשֵׁי עֹֽרֶף לוֹמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ צַדִּיקִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְלֹא חָטָֽאנוּ אֲבָל אֲנַֽחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ חָטָֽאנוּ:


Our God and God of our fathers, let our prayer come before you and do not ignore our supplication. For we are not so brazen-faced and stiff-necked to say to you, Adonoy, our God, and God of our fathers, “We are righteous and have not sinned.” But, indeed, we and our fathers have sinned.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 47

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/47](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/47)


אָשַֽׁמְנוּ. בָּגַֽדְנוּ. גָּזַֽלְנוּ. דִּבַּֽרְנוּ דֹּֽפִי. הֶעֱוִֽינוּ. וְהִרְשַֽׁעְנוּ. זַֽדְנוּ. חָמַֽסְנוּ. טָפַֽלְנוּ שֶֽׁקֶר. יָעַֽצְנוּ רָע. כִּזַּֽבְנוּ. לַֽצְנוּ. מָרַֽדְנוּ. נִאַֽצְנוּ. סָרַֽרְנוּ. עָוִֽינוּ. פָּשַֽׁעְנוּ. צָרַֽרְנוּ. קִשִּֽׁינוּ עֹֽרֶף. רָשַֽׁעְנוּ. שִׁחַֽתְנוּ. תִּעַֽבְנוּ. תָּעִֽינוּ. תִּעְתָּֽעְנוּ:


We have trespassed [against God and man, and we are devastated by our guilt]; We have betrayed [God and man, we have been ungrateful for the good done to us]; We have stolen; We have slandered. We have caused others to sin; We have caused others to commit sins for which they are called רְשָׁעִים, wicked; We have sinned with malicious intent; We have forcibly taken others' possessions even though we paid for them; We have added falsehood upon falsehood; We have joined with evil individuals or groups; We have given harmful advice; We have deceived; we have mocked; We have rebelled against God and His Torah; We have caused God to be angry with us; We have turned away from God's Torah; We have sinned deliberately; We have been negligent in our performance of the commandments; We have caused our friends grief; We have been stiff-necked, refusing to admit that our suffering is caused by our own sins. We have committed sins for which we are called רָשָׁע, [raising a hand to hit someone]. We have committed sins which are the result of moral corruption; We have committed sins which the Torah refers to as abominations; We have gone astray; We have led others astray.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 48

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/48](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/48)


סַֽרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ הַטּוֹבִים וְלֹא שָֽׁוָה לָֽנוּ. וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל הַבָּא עָלֵֽינוּ. כִּי אֱמֶת עָשִֽׂיתָ וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ:


We have turned away from Your commandments and from Your good laws, and we have gained nothing from it. And You are the Righteous One in all [punishment] that has come upon us; for You have acted truthfully and we have acted wickedly.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 49

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/49](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/49)


מַה נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יוֹשֵׁב מָרוֹם. וּמַה נְּסַפֵּר לְפָנֶֽיךָ שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים. הֲלֹא כָּל הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת וְהַנִּגְלוֹת אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ:


What shall we say before You, Who dwells on high; and what shall we relate to You Who dwells in the heavens? For everything, both hidden and revealed, You know.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 50

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/50](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/50)


אַתָּה יוֹדֵֽעַ רָזֵי עוֹלָם. וְתַעֲלוּמוֹת סִתְרֵי כָל חָי: אַתָּה חוֹפֵשׂ כָּל חַדְרֵי בָֽטֶן וּבוֹחֵן כְּלָיוֹת וָלֵב: אֵין דָּבָר נֶעְלָם מִמֶּֽךָּ. וְאֵין נִסְתָּר מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ: וּבְכֵן יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ. שֶׁתְּכַפֵּר לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ. וְתִסְלַח לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל עֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ. וּתִמְחָל לָֽנוּ עַל כָּל פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ:


You know the mysteries of the universe, and the hidden secrets of every individual. You search all our innermost thoughts, and probe our mind and heart. There is nothing hidden from You, and there is nothing concealed from Your sight. And so may it be Your will Adonoy our God and God of our fathers, that You pardon us for all our careless sins, and that You forgive us for all our deliberate sins, and that You grant us atonement for all our rebellious sins:


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 51

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/51](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/51)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאֹֽנֶס וּבְרָצוֹן:


For the sin we committed before You under compulsion³ and willingly.

footnotes:
³ Even a sin committed under duress needs to be forgiven, because many times a person allows himself to be placed in a predicament in which he is compelled to sin (e.g., leaving the office at a very late hour on the eve of Shabbos or Festival).—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 52

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/52](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/52)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאִמּוּץ הַלֵּב:


And for the sin we committed before You by callously hardening the heart.⁴

footnotes:
⁴ This would include not giving charity with a whole heart, and not helping a needy fellow Jew.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 53

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/53](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/53)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּבְלִי דָֽעַת:


For the sin we committed before You inadvertently.⁵

footnotes:
⁵ The literal meaning of בִּבְלִי דַעַת is “without knowledge,” and it implies not using our intellectual capabilities to study the laws of Torah and therewith gain the “knowledge” needed to observe the commandments properly.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 54

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/54](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/54)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּבִטּוּי שְׂפָתָֽיִם:


And for the sin we committed before You with an utterance of the lips.⁶

footnotes:
⁶ This includes the sins of making vows and oaths (even though they are kept), verbally insulting one’s fellowmen, and directing one’s displeasure against the decrees of Hashem.— Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 55

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/55](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/55)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּגָלוּי וּבַסָּֽתֶר:


For the sin we committed before You openly and secretly.⁷

footnotes:
⁷ A sin committed publicly could very well cause חִלוּל ה', the desecration of Hashem’s Name, and may also lead others to sin. A sin committed in secret, indicates that the sinner fears the reaction of people but is unafraid of Hashem’s displeasure.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 56

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/56](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/56)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּגִלּוּי עֲרָיוֹת:


And for the sin we committed before You in sexual immorality.⁸

footnotes:
⁸ This also includes such things that arouse desire for forbidden sexual relationships, such as embracing or dancing.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 57

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/57](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/57)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּדִבּוּר פֶּה:


For the sin we committed before You through [misuse of our power of] speech.⁹

footnotes:
⁹ This includes speaking the words of Torah in unclean places, cursing, humiliating someone; speaking of business matters on Shabbos, revealing another person’s secret, telling jokes and holding idle conversations in a house of worship (and certainly during the actual prayers) and telling lies.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 58

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/58](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/58)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּדַעַת וּבְמִרְמָה:


And for the sin we committed before You with knowledge and with deceit.¹⁰

footnotes:
¹⁰ This includes false advertising and dishonesty in business matters.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 59

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/59](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/59)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּהַרְהוֹר הַלֵּב:


For the sin we committed before You by improper thoughts.¹¹

footnotes:
¹¹ Evil thoughts, lustful thoughts, heretical thoughts, and suspicious thoughts about righteous people are included.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 60

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/60](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/60)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּהוֹנָֽאַת רֵֽעַ:


And for the sin we committed before You by cheating a fellow-man.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 61

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/61](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/61)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּוִדּוּי פֶּה:


For the sin we committed before You with [mere] verbal confession.¹²

footnotes:
¹² This refers to confession of sins without feeling regret for committing them and without earnest resolve to correct them in the future.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 62

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/62](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/62)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּוְעִידַת זְנוּת:


And for the sin we committed before You by joining in a lewd gathering.¹³

footnotes:
¹³ Any gathering or intimate meeting for the purpose of sexual immortality is included.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 63

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/63](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/63)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּזָדוֹן וּבִשְׁגָגָה:


For the sin we committed before You intentionally and unintentionally.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 64

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/64](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/64)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּזִלְזוּל הוֹרִים וּמוֹרִים:


And for the sin we committed before You by insufficient respect for parents and teachers.¹⁴

footnotes:
¹⁴ Not obeying their commands, not rising for a talmudic scholar and disrespect for one’s teacher even if he is not considered a “Torah Great” are included.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 65

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/65](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/65)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּחֹֽזֶק יָד:


For the sin we committed before You by using coercion [to harm others].¹⁵

footnotes:
¹⁵ This includes using physical, political or financial power to harm someone.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 66

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/66](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/66)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּחִלּוּל הַשֵּׁם:


And for the sin we committed before You by desecrating the Divine Name.¹⁶

footnotes:
¹⁶ This involves any sin committed that becomes public knowledge, including improper conduct with one’s fellow man.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 67

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/67](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/67)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּטִפְשׁוּת פֶּה:


For the sin we committed before You with foolish talk.¹⁷

footnotes:
¹⁷ This refers to idle talk and gossip.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 68

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/68](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/68)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּטֻמְאַת שְׂפָתָֽיִם:


And for the sin we committed before You with impurity of the lips.¹⁸

footnotes:
¹⁸ This includes profanity and unclean language.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 69

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/69](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/69)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּיֵֽצֶר הָרָע:


For the sin we committed before You with the Evil Inclination.¹⁹

footnotes:
¹⁹ When a person allows his Evil Inclination to rule over him, he commits a sin.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 70

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/70](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/70)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּיוֹדְעִים וּבְלֹא יוֹדְעִים:


And for the sin we committed before You knowingly and unknowingly.²⁰

footnotes:
²⁰ We ask Hashem to pardon us even for sins we are not aware that we committed, and also for such sins through which we caused damage but are not aware of the amount of loss incurred.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 71

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/71](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/71)


וְעַל כֻּלָּם אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת. סְלַח לָֽנוּ. מְחַל לָֽנוּ. כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ:


And for all of these, God of pardon, pardon us, forgive us, grant us atonement.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 72

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/72](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/72)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּכַפַּת שֹֽׁחַד:


For the sin we committed before You by forcing someone to give or take bribes.²¹

footnotes:
²¹ A bribe is not limited to money or gifts; it includes flattery or personal favors.— Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 73

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/73](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/73)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּכַֽחַשׁ וּבְכָזָב:


And for the sin we committed before You by false denial and false promise.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 74

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/74](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/74)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּלָשׁוֹן הָרָע:


For the sin we committed before You by evil talk [slander].²²

footnotes:
²² This includes causing a fellow Jew physical, monetary of social harm through passing degrading information about him to another person. It makes no difference whether this is done in his presence or behind his back, or if the information is true or false.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 75

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/75](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/75)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּלָצוֹן:


And for the sin we committed before You by scoffing.²³

footnotes:
²³ Ridicule of a person, a commandment, or guards of Torah are all included in the sin of scoffing.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 76

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/76](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/76)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּמַשָּׂא וּבְמַתָּן:


For the sin we committed before You in business dealings.²⁴

footnotes:
²⁴ This would include overcharging, misrepresenting, false-labeling and all other such deceitful practices.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 77

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/77](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/77)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּמַאֲכָל וּבְמִשְׁתֶּה:


And for the sin we committed before You in eating and drinking.²⁵

footnotes:
²⁵ Eating forbidden (non-kosher) foods, not saying the proper blessing or grace after meals, over-eating, are included in this sin.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 78

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/78](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/78)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּנֶֽשֶׁךְ וּבְמַרְבִּית:


For the sin we committed before You by [taking or giving] interest and by usury.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 79

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/79](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/79)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּנְטִיַּת גָּרוֹן:


And for the sin we committed before You by haughtily stretching forth the neck.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 80

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/80](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/80)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּשִׂקּוּר עָֽיִן:


For the sin we committed before You with gazing of the eyes.²⁶

footnotes:
²⁶ This refers to using the eyes to gaze at forbidden things.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 81

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/81](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/81)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּשִֽׂיחַ שִׂפְתוֹתֵֽינוּ:


And for the sin we committed before You by the prattle of our lips.²⁷

footnotes:
²⁷ This includes idle gossip, which is certainly forbidden in the synagogue at all times.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 82

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/82](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/82)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּעֵינַֽיִם רָמוֹת:


For the sin we committed before You with haughty eyes.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 83

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/83](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/83)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּעַזּוּת מֶֽצַח:


And for the sin we committed before You with impudence.²⁸

footnotes:
²⁸ Speaking “with chutzpah” to Torah scholars, or to someone more learned than himself is included in עַזּוּת מֵצַח.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 84

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/84](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/84)


וְעַל כֻּלָּם אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת. סְלַח לָֽנוּ. מְחַל לָֽנוּ. כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ:


And for all of these, God of pardon, pardon us, forgive us, grant us atonement.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 85

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/85](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/85)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּפְרִֽיקַת עֹל:


For the sin we committed before You by throwing off the yoke [of heaven].²⁹

footnotes:
²⁹ Rejecting an obligation to fulfill even a single commandment. Also included is shirking a religious obligation which must then be assumed by someone else.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 86

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/86](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/86)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּפְלִילוּת:


And for the sin we committed before You in passing judgment.³⁰

footnotes:
³⁰ This includes a “Dayan,” a judge who does not render correct decisions, and it also includes not giving someone the benefit of the doubt.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 87

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/87](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/87)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּצְדִיַּת רֵֽעַ:


For the sin we committed before You by entrapping a fellowman.³¹

footnotes:
³¹ This includes even attempting to harm someone; even if no harm was actually done, he still needs forgiveness.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 88

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/88](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/88)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּצָרוּת עָֽיִן:


And for the sin we committed before You by a begrudging eye.³²

footnotes:
³² Not doing a favor, not giving charity properly, and feeling bad at someone else’s success are included.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 89

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/89](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/89)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּקַלּוּת רֹאשׁ:


For the sin we committed before You by lightmindedness.³³

footnotes:
³³ Lightmindedness or frivolity in the synagogue or Bais Midrash or while wearing tefillin are serious sins.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 90

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/90](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/90)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּקַשְׁיוּת עֹֽרֶף:


And for the sin we committed before You by being stiff-necked [stubborn].³⁴

footnotes:
³⁴ Rejecting admonition and “ignoring” punishment are included. Also included is brushing aside illness, financial loss, and humiliation as mere coincidences rather than manifestations of Divine displeasure.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 91

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/91](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/91)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּרִיצַת רַגְלַֽיִם לְהָרַע:


For the sin we committed before You by running to do evil.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 92

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/92](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/92)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּרְכִילוּת:


And for the sin we committed before You by talebearing.³⁵

footnotes:
³⁵ This refers to carrying tales, even true ones, about one person to another, and the one who listens to these tales is also included in this category of sin.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 93

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/93](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/93)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּשְׁבֽוּעַת שָׁוְא:


For the sin we committed before You by swearing in vain.³⁶

footnotes:
³⁶ This includes swearing falsely or even swearing a useless oath.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 94

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/94](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/94)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּשִׂנְאַת חִנָּם:


And for the sin we committed before You by unwarranted hatred.³⁷

footnotes:
³⁷ Hating someone because of jealousy, or because he doesn’t conform to your ideas of ettiquete.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 95

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/95](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/95)


עַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בִּתְשֽׂוּמֶת יָד:


For the sin we committed before You by breach of trust.³⁸

footnotes:
³⁸ Denying that you owe someone a monetary debt when he asks for payment.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 96

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/96](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/96)


וְעַל חֵטְא שֶׁחָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּתִמְהוֹן לֵבָב:


And for the sin we committed before You by a confused heart.³⁹

footnotes:
³⁹ This includes sins committed because of confusion, worry or pain, it also includes the sin of harboring doubts about the authenticity of the laws enacted by our Sages, and doubts about the fundamental principles of our faith, such as Divine Providence, reward and punishment, and also doubts about the authenticity of the Torah and the Prophets.—Siddur HaGra


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 97

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/97](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/97)


וְעַל כֻּלָּם אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת. סְלַח לָֽנוּ. מְחַל לָֽנוּ. כַּפֶּר לָֽנוּ:


And for all of these, God of pardon, pardon us, forgive us, grant us atonement.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 98

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/98](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/98)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹלָה:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a burnt-offering.⁴⁰

footnotes:
⁴⁰ A burnt-offering is brought for failure to fulfill any positive commandment, e.g, putting on non-kosher tefillin.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 99

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/99](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/99)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם חַטָּאת:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a sin-offering.⁴¹

footnotes:
⁴¹ A sin-offering is brought for unintentionally transgressing any prohibitive commandment punishable by excision (כָּרֵת) if it were done with intent.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 100

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/100](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/100)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם קָרְבַּן עוֹלֶה וְיוֹרֵד:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a “fluctuating” offering.⁴²

footnotes:
⁴² The fluctuating offering is an offering that varies in value according to the financial means of the individual who brings it. (The literal meaning of עוֹלָה וְיוֹרֵד, is “go up and down”). This type of offering is brought when a person swore falsely (unintentionally) concerning something he did or did not do. For example, one may have thought he ate something and consequently swore that he ate it, but in reality he did not and thus he swore falsely.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 101

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/101](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/101)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם אָשָׁם וַדַּאי וְתָלוּי:


And for sins for which we are obligated to bring a guilt-offering for certain or for doubtful trespasses.⁴³

footnotes:
⁴³ This type of sacrifice was brought in an instance where it is uncertain whether or not a violation occurred. For example it is not known whether a substance he ate was of a forbidden nature or if it was permitted.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 102

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/102](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/102)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם מַכַּת מַרְדּוּת:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of lashing for violations of Rabbinic law.⁴⁴

footnotes:
⁴⁴ A Rabbinic Court had the right to impose lashing for a violation of a rabbinic injunction.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 103

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/103](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/103)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם מַלְקוּת אַרְבָּעִים:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of forty lashes.⁴⁵

footnotes:
⁴⁵ Forty lashes proscribed by the Torah was given to one who actively and intentionally violated any of the prohibitive commandments, providing he was forewarned and the act was witnessed by two witnesses.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 104

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/104](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/104)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם מִיתָה בִּידֵי שָׁמָֽיִם:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of death at the hand of Heaven.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 105

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/105](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/105)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם כָּרֵת וַעֲרִירִי:


And for sins for which we incur the penalty of excision and childlessness.⁴⁶

footnotes:
⁴⁶ One who intentionally does work or eats on Yom Kippur, or one who eats chometz — leavened bread — on Pesach, is punished with excision and childlessness.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 106

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/106](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/106)


וְעַל חֲטָאִים שֶׁאָֽנוּ חַיָּבִים עֲלֵיהֶם אַרְבַּע מִיתוֹת בֵּית דִּין. סְקִילָה. שְׂרֵפָה. הֶֽרֶג. וְחֶֽנֶק.


And for sins for which we are liable to any of the four death penalties inflicted by the [Rabbinic] Court [which are]: stoning, burning, beheading or strangulation.⁴⁷

footnotes:
⁴⁷ Stoning is the penalty for knowingly desecrating Shabbos, burning is the penalty for certain forbidden sexual relationships, beheading is the penalty for murder, and strangulation is the penalty for adultery.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 107

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/107](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/107)


עַל מִצְוַת עֲשֵׂה וְעַל מִצְוַת לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה. בֵּין שֶׁיֶּשׁ בָּהּ קוּם עֲשֵׂה. וּבֵין שֶׁאֵין בָּהּ קוּם עֲשֵׂה. אֶת הַגְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ וְאֶת שֶׁאֵינָם גְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ. אֶת הַגְּלוּיִים לָֽנוּ כְּבָר אֲמַרְנוּם לְפָנֶֽיךָ. וְהוֹדִֽינוּ לְךָ עֲלֵיהֶם. וְאֶת שֶׁאֵינָם גְּלוּיִם לָֽנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ הֵם גְּלוּיִים וִידוּעִים. כַּדָּבָר שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר הַנִּסְתָּרֹת לַיהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ. וְהַנִּגְלֹת לָֽנוּ וּלְבָנֵֽינוּ עַד עוֹלָם. לַעֲשׂוֹת אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי הַתּוֹרָה הַזֹּאת: כִּי אַתָּה סָלְחָן לְיִשְׂרָאֵל וּמָחֳלָן לְשִׁבְטֵי יְשֻׁרוּן בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר וּמִבַּלְעָדֶֽיךָ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה:


For [transgressing] positive commandments, and for [transgressing] prohibitive commandments, whether the prohibition can be corrected by a specifically prescribed act,⁴⁸ or whether it cannot be corrected by a specifically prescribed act, for those of which we are aware and for those of which we are not aware. For those of which we are aware, we have already declared before You and confessed them unto You; and for those of which we are not aware, before You they are revealed and known, as it is said, “The hidden things belong to Adonoy, our God, but the revealed things are for us and for our children forever, that we might fulfill all the words of this Torah.”⁴⁹ For You are the Pardoner of Yisrael, and the Forgiver of the tribes of Yeshurun in every generation, and beside You, we have no King Who forgives and pardons—only You!

footnotes:
⁴⁸ For example returning the stolen money would be a corrective measure for the prohibition of stealing.
⁴⁹ Devorim 29:28.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 108

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/108](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/108)


אֱלֹהַי. עַד שֶׁלֹּא נוֹצַֽרְתִּי אֵינִי כְדַאי, וְעַכְשָׁו שֶׁנּוֹצַֽרְתִּי כְּאִלּוּ לֹא נוֹצַֽרְתִּי. עָפָר אֲנִי בְּחַיָּי. קַל וָחֹֽמֶר בְּמִיתָתִי. הֲרֵי אֲנִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ כִּכְלִי מָלֵא בוּשָׁה וּכְלִמָּה. יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי שֶׁלֹּא אֶחֱטָא עוֹד. וּמַה שֶּׁחָטָֽאתִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ מָרֵק בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים. אֲבָל לֹא עַל יְדֵי יִסּוּרִים וָחֳלָיִם רָעִים:


God, before I was formed, I was unworthy [to be created]. And now that I have been formed, it is as if I had not been formed. I am like dust while I live, how much more so when I am dead. Here I am before You like a vessel filled with shame. May it be Your will, Adonoy, my God, and the God of my fathers, that I shall sin no more, and the sins I have committed before You, cleanse them in Your abundant mercies; but not through suffering and severe illness.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 109

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/109](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/109)


אֱלֹהַי נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ תִּרְדּוֹף נַפְשִׁי וְכֹל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם: עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן יְמִינֶֽךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶֽךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ. לְמַֽעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶֽיךָ הוֹשִֽׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵֽנִי: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:


My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceitfully. To those who curse me, may my soul be unresponsive; and let my soul be like dust to all. Open my heart to Your Torah and let my soul pursue Your commandments. And all who plan evil against me, quickly annul their counsel and frustrate their intention. Act for the sake of Your Name. Act for the sake of Your right hand. Act for the sake of Your holiness. Act for the sake of Your Torah. In order that Your loved ones be released, deliver [with] Your right hand and answer me. May the words of my mouth be acceptable and the thoughts of my heart — before You Adonoy, my Rock and my Redeemer.

עֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:


He Who makes the peace in His high heavens may He make peace upon us and upon all Yisrael and say Amein.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Shemoneh Esrei 111

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/111](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Shemoneh%20Esrei/r/111)


יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ: וְשָׁם נַעֲבָדְךָ בְּיִרְאָה כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִיּוֹת: וְעָרְבָה לַיהֹוָה מִנְחַת יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלָֽםִ כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִיּוֹת:


May it be Your will, Adonoy, our God, and the God of our Fathers that the Holy Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our share in Your Torah. And there we will serve You reverently as in the days of old, and in earlier years. And let Adonoy be pleased with the offerings of Yehudah and Yerushalayim as in the days of old and in earlier years.

**בָּרוּךְ**אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא אֵל עֶלְיוֹן גּוֹמֵל חֲסָדִים טוֹבִים וְקוֹנֵה הַכֹּל וְזוֹכֵר חַסְדֵי אָבוֹת וּמֵבִיא גוֹאֵל לִבְנֵי בְנֵיהֶם לְמַֽעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָה:


**Blessed** are You, Adonoy, our God, and God of our fathers, God of Avraham, God of Yitzchak, and God of Yaakov, the Almighty, the Great, the Powerful, the Awesome, most high Almighty, Who bestows beneficent kindness, Who possesses everything, Who remembers the piety of the Patriarchs, and Who brings a redeemer to their children's children, for the sake of His Name, with love.

מִסּוֹד חֲכָמִים וּנְבוֹנִים. וּמִלֶּֽמֶד דַּֽעַת מְבִינִים. אֶפְתְּחָה פִי בִּתְפִלָּה וּבְתַחֲנוּנִים. לְחַלּוֹת וּלְחַנֵּן פְּנֵי מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹחֵל וְסוֹלֵֽחַ לַעֲו‍ֹנִים:


Invoking the doctrines of our wise and understanding Sages, and with the teachings [acquired] from their perceptive intuition, I open my mouth in prayer and supplication to plead and seek favor before the presence of the King, Forgiver and Pardoner of iniquities.

שׁוֹשַׁן עֵֽמֶק אֲיֻמָּה. שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן לְקַיְּמָה. שֹֽׁרֶשׁ וְעָנָף סֻיְּמָה. שָׁוִים יַֽחַד לְצַיְּמָה: בְּעֵת מָֽטוּ יְסוֹדוֹתֶֽיהָ. בָּטְחָה בְּחִין מוֹסְדוֹתֶֽיהָ. בָּם תָּקְעָה יְתֵדוֹתֶֽיהָ. בְּכֶֽפֶל לְהַשְׁעִין יְדוֹתֶֽיהָ: תָּמְכָה בְּפֹֽעַל צוּרִים. תֻּמַּת הֵֽמָּה הַיּוֹצְרִים. תְּרוּפָה תֵּת לַעֲצוּרִים. תֵּבֵל לְהַאֲפִיל לְצָרִים: שְׁתִילֵי גְבָעוֹת אַרְבַּע. שַֽׁאַג סֵֽפֶר הַמְרֻבָּע. שֶֽׁוַע פְּגִיעוֹת אַרְבַּע. שְׁעֵה צִדְקָם לִתְבַּע: בִּֽיטָה בְּמִתְהַלֵּךְ תָּמִים. בְּמוּסַר לְחוּמוֹ חֲתוּמִים. בְּצִדְקוֹ תָּדִֽיחַ כְּתָמִים. בְּאֶֽפֶס אוּרִים וְתֻמִּים: תְּמוּר תַּשְׁלֽוּמֵי פָר. תָּבִין הֶֽגֶג הַמְסֻפָּר. תּוֹקְעֵי בַחֹֽדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר. תַּלְאוּבָם בְּכִפּוּר יְכֻפָּר: וְשַׁכֵּךְ חֲמַת זַעְמָךְ. וְתָחוֹן שְׂרִידֵי עַמָּךְ וְעָלֵֽינוּ יְהִי נוֹעֲמָךְ. וְנִחְיֶה מִמְּקוֹר עִמָּךְ: נָאוֹר עִמְּךָ הַסְּלִיחָה. נָכוֹן מַהֵר לְסָלְחָה: חזן נִיב שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ הַצְלִֽיחָה. נַֽאַק שְׁמָֽעָה וּסְלָֽחָה: שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ מְדוֹבְבוֹת יְשֵׁנִים. יְנַצְּחֽוּךָ כְּעַל שׁוֹשַׁנִּים: חזן חֲדָשִׁים וְגַם יְשָׁנִים. בְּמָגִנַּת אָב נִשְׁעָנִים:

זָכְרֵֽנוּ לְחַיִּים מֶֽלֶךְ חָפֵץ בַּחַיִּים וְכָתְבֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר הַחַיִּים לְמַעַנְךָ אֱלֹהִים חַיִּים:

אַתָּה גִבּוֹר לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי מְחַיֶּה מֵתִים אַתָּה רַב לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ: מְכַלְכֵּל חַיִּים בְּחֶֽסֶד מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים סוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְרוֹפֵא חוֹלִים וּמַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וּמְקַיֵּם אֱמוּנָתוֹ לִישֵׁנֵי עָפָר, מִי כָמֽוֹךָ בַּֽעַל גְּבוּרוֹת וּמִי דּֽוֹמֶה לָּךְ מֶֽלֶךְ מֵמִית וּמְחַיֶּה וּמַצְמִֽיחַ יְשׁוּעָה:


You are mighty forever, my Master; You are the Resurrector of the dead the Powerful One to deliver us. Sustainer of the living with kindliness, Resurrector of the dead with great mercy, Supporter of the fallen, and Healer of the sick, and Releaser of the imprisoned, and Fulfiller of His faithfulness to those who sleep in the dust. Who is like You, Master of mighty deeds, and who can be compared to You? King Who causes death and restores life, and causes deliverance to sprout forth.

יוֹם מִיָּמִים הוּחָס. יוֹם כִּפּוּר הַמְּיֻחָס. יוֹדְעָיו חֲמוֹל וְחָס. יוֹקְשָׁיו לְפוֹעֶֽרֶת הָס: וּבוֹ בְּתַחְבֻּלּוֹת יוּעָֽצוּ. וִדּוּי בְּתַֽחַן יָאִֽיצוּ. וְשׁוֹכְנֵי עָפָר יָקִֽיצוּ. וּמֵרֹאשׁ הָרִים יָלִֽיצוּ: מִפְעֲלוֹת עוֹקֵד וְעָקוּד. מֵאָז בְּיָדָם פָּקוּד. מוֹפֵת הַכָּמוּס לְפִקּוּד. מוֹקֵשׁ לְהַבְעִית בְּסִקּוּד: כְּהַבְטָחַת סְבִֽיכַת אַֽיִל. כָּפְרוֹ הַנָּצוּר לְחַֽיִל. כֵּן תַּעֲצִים חַֽיִל. כּוֹרְעֶֽיךָ בְּעֶֽצֶם וָלָֽיִל: פַּחְדּוֹ יָחִיל שׁוֹטְמִים. פִּיּוֹתָם הֱיוֹת אֲטוּמִים. פְּרָחָיו בְּמִשְׁעֲנוֹתָיו חֲטוּמִים. פַּלְּטֵם מֵרֶֽכֶל פִּטּוּמִים: וְאִם אֵין מַעֲשִׂים. וְזֶֽבַח מִבְּלִי מֵשִׂים. וְזָכְרָה לְנִבְזִים וּמְאוּסִים. וּמִגִּזְעָם הָפֵר כְּעָסִים: רָם קשְׁטְ מַעְבָּדֶֽיךָ. רָאֹה תִרְאֶה עוֹבְדֶֽיךָ. רֵעִים בָּאֵי עָדֶֽיךָ. רַחוּם זְכֹר לַעֲבָדֶֽיךָ: יְבֻקַּשׁ עָו‍ֹן וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ. יָֽמָּה בִּמְצוּלוֹת תְּנֶֽנּוּ. יֶֽלֶד בְּשַׁעֲשׁוּעָיו תַעֲנֶֽנּוּ. יֽשֶׁר מֵלִיץ יְחָנֶֽנּוּ: מִבְּרַק חֶֽרֶב הַשָּׁנוּן. מַלֵּט מַאֲרִיכֵי רִנּוּן: חזן מַלֵּא מִשְׁאֲלוֹתָם בְּתַחֲנוּן. מֶֽלֶךְ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן: כֹּֽפֶר פִּדְיוֹן נֶֽפֶשׁ. פְּדֵה מִטְּבִיעַת רֶֽפֶשׁ: חזן מְיַחֲלֶֽיךָ בְּעִנּוּי וָכֹֽפֶשׁ. הַחֲיֵם בְּטַלְלֵי נֹֽפֶשׁ:

וּבְכֵן אַךְ חַנּוּן אַתָּה וְרַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל:


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 108

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/108](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/108)


אַךְ אוֹמְרִים בְּחִין לְפָנֶֽיךָ. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ בָּאִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְפָנֶֽיךָ. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ גָּשִׁים בִּתְפִלָּה לְפָנֶֽיךָ. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ דּוֹרְשִׁים בְּדָתְךָ יוֹמָם וָלַֽיְלָה. חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ הוֹגִים בְּהַלֵּל וְתִשְׁבָּחוֹת. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ וְאוֹמְרִים סְלַח נָא לַעֲו‍ֹנֵֽינוּ. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ זוֹעֲקִים בִּתְפִלָּה לְפָנֶֽיךָ. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ חוֹקְרִים סוֹד בְּרִיתֶֽךָ. כִּי אֵין בִּלְתֶּֽךָ. חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ טוֹעֲנִים שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל. כִּי אֵין כָּאֵל. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ יוֹדְעִים שֵׁם הַמְפֹרָשׁ. וּבְפִיהֶם יִתְפָּרָשׁ. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ כֻּלָּם הַיּוֹם כְּמַלְאָכִים. קְדֻשָּׁה לְפָנֶֽיךָ עוֹרְכִים. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ לְבוּשֵׁיהֶם נְקִיִּים. וְכֻלָּם צָמִים וּמִתְעַנִּים. חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם מַגִּידִים. וַחֲטָאֵיהֶם מְתַנִּים. סְלַח נָא עוֹנִים. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ נִקְרָאִים הַיּוֹם. וְסָלַחְתִּי לָכֶם הַיּוֹם. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ סְפוּרִים כְּחֹל הַיָּם. וַעֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵיהֶם תַּשְׁלִיךְ בִּמְצוּלוֹת יָם. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ עוֹנִים אַרְבַּע קְדֻשּׁוֹת. לִפְנֵי חוֹקֵר כְּלָיוֹת. וְיוֹדֵעַ כָּל נִסְתָּרוֹת. חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ פָּקְדֵם לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים. וְטַהֲרֵם בְּמַֽיִם חַיִּים. כִּי עִמְּךָ מְקוֹר חַיִּים. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ צוֹעֲקִים אָֽנָּא אֵל נָא. סְלַח נָא חֵטְא לְמִי מָנָה. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ קוֹלָם בְּרַֽעַשׁ מַרְעִישִׁים. קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קוֹרְאִים אָבוֹת וּבָנִים. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ רִאשׁוֹן וְאַחֲרוֹן אַתָּה. לְמַעַנְךָ עֲשֵׂה גַּם עַתָּה. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: אַךְ שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ. בְּקָרְאֵֽנוּ אֵלֶֽיךָ עֲנֵֽנוּ. כִּי אַתָּה רַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל: חזן אַךְ תּוֹלִים לְךָ עֵינֵיהֶם. עֲנֵם וּשְׁמַע בְּקוֹל תְּפִלּוֹתֵיהֶם. סְלַח נָא לַעֲו‍ֹנוֹתֵיהֶם. חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם לְכָל פֹּֽעַל:

And thus, praise God! How awesome are Your works.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 111

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/111](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/111)


**אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים.** אֵל מֶלֶךְ בְּעוֹלָמוֹ. מֵחִישׁ פְּדוּת עַמּוֹ. לְקַיֵּים דְּבַר נָאֳמוֹ. כִּי סְלִיחָה עִמּוֹ. הוֹדוּ לַיהֹוָה קִרְאוּ בִשְׁמוֹ:


**Praise God.** Almighty, King of His universe, He hastens to redeem His people, to fulfill the word of his promise, for pardon rests with Him; Give thanks to Adonoy, proclaim His Name,


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 112

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/112](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/112)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים. בָּרוּךְ וּמְהֻלָּל בְּרֹב גָּדְלוֹ. מֵחִישׁ סְלִיחָה לִקְהָלוֹ. לְהַרְאוֹת לַכֹּל גָּדְלוֹ. מָדַד מַיִם בְּשָׁעֳלוֹ. שִׁירוּ לוֹ זַמְּרוּ לוֹ:


Praise God! Blessed and praised in His abundant greatness, He hastens to pardon His community [Yisrael], that they all may see His greatness, He measured the waters in the hollow of His hand; sing to Him, chant hymns to Him,


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 113

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/113](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/113)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים. גּוֹאֵל עַם קְדוֹשׁוֹ. בִּסְלִיחָה לְהַקְדִּישׁוֹ. וּמְכוֹנֵן בֵּית מִקְדָּשׁוֹ. לְזֶרַע אַבְרָהָם קְדוֹשׁוֹ. הִתְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ:


Praise God! He redeems His holy people, with pardon, He sanctifies them, and He established his Holy Temple for the seed of Avraham, His holy one; take pride in uttering His Holy Name,


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 114

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/114](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/114)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים. דָּגוּל מְשֻׁבָּח בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ. סוֹלֵחַ לְעַם זוּ בָּזוֹ. בִּדְבַר עֻזּוֹ וּמָעֻזּוֹ. לָכֵן עֲדַת מָעֻזּוֹ. דִּרְשׁוּ יְהֹוָה וְעֻזּוֹ:


Praise God! Eminent One! Praised in the firmament of His might, He pardons this people [Yisrael] this [day] according to His mighty word; therefore, His mighty congregation seek Adonoy and His might,


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 115

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/115](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/115)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים. הַכֹּל בְּמַאֲמַר עָשָׂה. וְהוּא פָעַל וְעָשָׂה. סוֹלֵחַ לְאוֹם עֲמוּסָה. לָכֵן עַם בּוֹ חָסָה. זִכְרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה:


Praise God! He made all things with His word, and He performed and accomplished [all], He pardons the nation that He carries; therefore, His people trust in Him. Remember the wonders He has performed,


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 116

אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים. וּמֵקִים דְּבַר עַבְדּוֹ. עַל אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמַיִם הוֹדוֹ. סוֹלֵחַ לְעַם מְיַחֲדוֹ. אֲשֶׁר נִקְרְאוּ בִּדְבַר סוֹדוֹ. זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹ:


Praise God. He confirms the word of His servant; over the earth and the heavens is His majesty. He forgives the people who proclaim His Oneness, who are referred to in His holy words, as the seed of Yisrael, His servant.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 117

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/117](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/117)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים. זֶה רוֹקַע הָאָרֶץ. הַיּוֹשֵׁב עַל חוּג הָאָרֶץ. סוֹלֵחַ לְגוֹי אֶחָד בָּאָרֶץ. לָכֵן אִמְרוּ לְיוֹסֵד הָאָרֶץ. הוּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכָל הָאָרֶץ:


Praise God! He spread forth the earth, He dwells above the circle of the earth, He pardons the unique nation on earth; therefore, praise the Founder of the earth, He is Adonoy, our God, throughout the earth.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 118

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/118](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/118)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים. חַי בִּמְעוֹנָתוֹ. חַנּוּן וְחוֹנֵן עֲדָתוֹ. יָשׁוּב בְּרַחֲמִים לְבֵיתוֹ. לָכֵן לְבָאֵי בִּבְרִיתוֹ. זִכְרוּ לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ:


Praise God! He lives in His Habitation [His Temple], the Gracious One is gracious to His congregation, He will return in mercy to His House, therefore, you who have entered His covenant, remember His covenant forever.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 119

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/119](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/119)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים. טַפֵּי נַחֲלָתוֹ. טְלָאֵי יְרֻשָּׁתוֹ. יְקַיֵּם עָלֵימוֹ אִמְרָתוֹ. כְּחָקוּק בְּתוֹרָתוֹ. אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת אַבְרָהָם וּשְׁבוּעָתוֹ:


Praise God! The children of His heritage [Yisrael], the lambs of His inheritance [Yisrael], for them He will confirm His word, engraved in His Torah, the covenant He made with Avraham and His oath [to Yitzchak].


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 120

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/120](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/120)


אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים. יוֹעֵץ מֵישָׁרִים לְחוֹק. יְרֵאָיו לְחַיִּים לָחוֹק. סוֹלֵחַ לַחֵטְא לִמְחוֹק. כְּנִשְׁמַע לְרוֹעֶה מֵרָחוֹק. וַיַּעֲמִידֶהָ לְיַעֲקֹב לְחוֹק:


Praise God! He devises upright statutes, those who fear Him, are inscribed for life, He pardons sins and blots it out, as was heard by [Moshe], the shepherd of old;¹ He established it for Yaakov as a statute.

footnotes:
¹ Moshe, the faithful shepherd of Yisrael, pleaded to Hashem to pardon his flock. Hashem answered him, “I have pardoned them according to your word (סָלַחְתִּי כִּדְבָרֶךָ).”

אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים. תַּקִּיף אֱלֹהֵי עוֹלָם. דְּבָרוֹ נִצָּב לְעוֹלָם. וְהוּא מִכֹּל נֶעְלָם. וַאֲנַחְנוּ מְהַלְלִים שְׁמוֹ לְעוֹלָם. בָּרוּךְ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם:


Praise God! Powerful is eternal God, His word is firm forever, and He is hidden from all, and we praise His Name forever. Blessed is Adonoy, the God of Yisrael from this world to the next.

And thus great are the works of our God!


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 123

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/123](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/123)


**מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵינוּ.** אַדִּיר בְּוִעוּדוֹ. בְּרוּם וּבְתַחַת הוֹדוֹ. גִּלָּה אוֹר לְעַבְדּוֹ. דָּבָר מֵקִים לְעַבְדּוֹ. לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה אֵין עוֹד מִלְּבַדּוֹ:


**The work of our God!** He is mighty amid His [Divine] assembly, in the heights and below is His majesty, He revealed His light to [Moshe]² His servant. He confirms His word to His servant, therefore, will He be exalted. There is none else besides Him,

footnotes:
² This refers to the Torah which is called אוֹר, light. Thus Hashem revealed His light to Moshe at Sinai.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 124

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/124](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Machzor%20Yom%20Kippur%20Ashkenaz/s/Musaf%20for%20Yom%20Kippur,_Reader%27s%20Repetition%20of%20the%20Amidah/r/124)


מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵינוּ. הַמַּכִּיר עוֹלְמֵי עַד. וְסוֹפֵר וּמוֹנֶה עֲדֵי עַד. זִיו מוֹשָׁבוֹ נוֹעַד. חֶלֶד צוֹפֶה בְּמִסְעָד. לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה הַמַּבִּיט לָאָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָד:


The work of our God. He is cognizant of all the worlds, He numbers and counts all the worlds, the splendor of His throne is established, He looks at the earth³ and sustains it; therefore, will He be exalted, He Who looks at the earth and it trembles.

footnotes:
³ Hashem looks at the earth and sees what it requires, i.e. rainfall, sunshine, etc. and He sustains it.


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 125

מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵינוּ. טוֹעֵן עוֹלָמוֹ. יוֹדֵעַ הֲדוֹמוֹ. כִּלְּלוֹ בְּנָאֳמוֹ. לָעַד לַהֲקִימוֹ. לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ:


The work of our God! He carries the world, He knows His footstool,⁴ He created it all with His word, to establish it forever; therefore, will He be exalted, Adonoy of Hosts is His Name.

footnotes:
⁴ Hashem knows the needs of those who inhabit the earth which is referred to as His footstool (וְהָאָרֶץ הֲדוֹם רַגְלָיו).


###### Machzor Yom Kippur Ashkenaz, Musaf for Yom Kippur, Reader's Repetition of the Amidah 126

מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵינוּ. מוֹשֵׁל בְּמִפְעָלוֹ. נוֹרָא עַל זְבוּלוֹ. סִלּוּדוֹ כְּגָדְלוֹ. עֻזּוֹ כְּרֹב חֵילוֹ. לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה שְׂרָפִים עוֹמְדִים מִמַּעַל לוֹ:


The work of our God! He rules over His work; He is awesome over His Habitation, His praise conforms to His greatness, His might conforms to the multitude of His host [of angels]; therefore will He be exalted, the Seraphim stand by Him.

מַעֲשֵׂה אֱלֹהֵינוּ. פְּאֵרוֹ בִּשְׁמֵי מְעוֹנַי. צוֹפֶה וּמַבִּיט לְעֵינַי. קִלּוּס שְׁמוֹ בַּהֲמוֹנַי. רוֹדֶה בְּקֶרֶב מוֹנַי. לָכֵן יִתְגָּאֶה גְּדוֹלִים מַעֲשֵׂי יְהֹוָה:


The work of our God! His glory is in the high heavens. He scrutinizes and looks searchingly, His Name is acclaimed by multitudes, He dominates my oppressors; therefore will He be exalted, great is the work of Adonoy!

מַעֲשֵׂה אֱנוֹשׁ וְתַחְבֻּלוֹתָיו מְזִמָּה. שִׁבְתּוֹ בְּתוֹךְ מִרְמָה. רְפִידָתוֹ רִמָּה. קָבוּר בִּסְעִיף אֲדָמָה. וְאֵיךְ יִתְגָּאֶה אָדָם לַהֶבֶל דָּמָה:


The work of mortal man, his plans are mischievous, his habitation is in the midst of deceit, his bed is with the worms, he is buried in the cleft of the earth; how then can he be exalted, [this] man who is like vanity?

**ונתנה תקף**
